```{r}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(labelled)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(mice)
library(lubridate)
library(msm)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(scales)
```


# Load data
```{r}
hrs_long_path <- "data/hrs_long.csv"

hrs_long <- read_csv(
  hrs_long_path,
  col_types = cols(
    hhidpn = col_character(),
    year   = col_integer(),
    .default = col_guess()
  )
)

baseline_start <- 2004L
baseline_end   <- 2010L

# 0) Apply cummax to dementia — make it irreversible
hrs_long_fixed <- hrs_long %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, year) %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  mutate(
    dementia = as.integer(cummax(coalesce(dementia, 0L)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

revert_check <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, year) %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  mutate(reverted = !is.na(lag(dementia)) & lag(dementia) == 1 & dementia == 0) %>%
  ungroup()
cat("Reversions after cummax fix:", sum(revert_check$reverted, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\nDementia person-waves after cummax:",
    sum(hrs_long_fixed$dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Unique dementia people:",
    n_distinct(hrs_long_fixed$hhidpn[hrs_long_fixed$dementia == 1]), "\n")

# 1) Identify baseline year per person
#    Require: age >= 50, dementia == 0, hearing_loss, vision_overall, Frailty_status not missing
baseline_tbl <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  filter(year >= baseline_start, year <= baseline_end) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age), age >= 50) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dementia), dementia == 0) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hearing_loss)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(vision_overall)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Frailty_status)) %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  summarise(baseline_year = min(year), .groups = "drop")

cat("\nParticipants with valid baseline:", nrow(baseline_tbl), "\n")

# 2) Extract the baseline row (one per person)
baseline_df <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  inner_join(baseline_tbl, by = "hhidpn") %>%
  filter(year == baseline_year) %>%
  distinct(hhidpn, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 3) Build panel: baseline + all follow-up waves
panel_df <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  inner_join(baseline_tbl, by = "hhidpn") %>%
  filter(year >= baseline_year)

# 4) Eligibility: ≥2 valid waves on each measure; has follow-up
eligible_ids <- panel_df %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rounds         = n(),
    n_hearing_valid  = sum(!is.na(hearing_loss)),
    n_vision_valid   = sum(!is.na(vision_overall)),
    n_frailty_valid  = sum(!is.na(Frailty_status)),
    n_dementia_valid = sum(!is.na(dementia)),
    has_fu           = any(year > baseline_year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_rounds         >= 2,
    n_hearing_valid  >= 2,
    n_vision_valid   >= 2,
    n_frailty_valid  >= 2,
    n_dementia_valid >= 2,
    has_fu
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn)

baseline_df_eligible <- baseline_df %>%
  semi_join(eligible_ids, by = "hhidpn")

panel_df_eligible <- panel_df %>%
  semi_join(eligible_ids, by = "hhidpn")

cat("\nFinal eligible participants:", nrow(baseline_df_eligible), "\n")
cat("Final person-waves:", nrow(panel_df_eligible), "\n")

# 5) Join death tracking — keep deceased individuals
death_track_clean <- death_track %>%
  mutate(
    hhidpn      = as.character(hhidpn),
    death_month = if_else(death_month == 98, NA_real_, as.numeric(death_month)),
    death_month = if_else(died == 1 & is.na(death_month), 6, death_month),
    death_date  = if_else(
      died == 1 & !is.na(death_year) & !is.na(death_month),
      lubridate::make_date(death_year, death_month, 15),
      as.Date(NA)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, death_year, death_month, death_date, died)

panel_df_eligible <- panel_df_eligible %>%
  left_join(death_track_clean, by = "hhidpn")

baseline_df_eligible <- baseline_df_eligible %>%
  left_join(death_track_clean, by = "hhidpn")

cat("\nDeceased in eligible cohort:",
    sum(baseline_df_eligible$died == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Person-waves with death info:",
    sum(!is.na(panel_df_eligible$death_date)), "\n")

```



# Summary
# HRS — EXCLUSION FLOW WITH DEMENTIA ACCOUNTING
```{r}
# Step 0: Total pool
all_ids <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  summarise(ever_dem = as.integer(any(dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

n_total   <- nrow(all_ids)
dem_total <- sum(all_ids$ever_dem)

# Step 1: In baseline window
ids_s1 <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  filter(year >= baseline_start, year <= baseline_end) %>%
  distinct(hhidpn)
ids_excl_s1 <- all_ids %>% anti_join(ids_s1, by = "hhidpn")
dem_excl_s1 <- sum(ids_excl_s1$ever_dem)

# Step 2: Age >= 50
ids_s2 <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  filter(year >= baseline_start, year <= baseline_end,
         !is.na(age), age >= 50) %>%
  distinct(hhidpn)
ids_excl_s2 <- ids_s1 %>% anti_join(ids_s2, by = "hhidpn")
dem_excl_s2 <- sum(all_ids %>% semi_join(ids_excl_s2, by = "hhidpn") %>% pull(ever_dem))

# Step 3: Dementia-free at baseline
ids_s3 <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  filter(year >= baseline_start, year <= baseline_end,
         !is.na(age), age >= 50,
         !is.na(dementia), dementia == 0) %>%
  distinct(hhidpn)
ids_excl_s3 <- ids_s2 %>% anti_join(ids_s3, by = "hhidpn")
dem_excl_s3 <- sum(all_ids %>% semi_join(ids_excl_s3, by = "hhidpn") %>% pull(ever_dem))

# Step 4: Non-missing hearing_loss at baseline
ids_s4 <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  filter(year >= baseline_start, year <= baseline_end,
         !is.na(age), age >= 50,
         !is.na(dementia), dementia == 0,
         !is.na(hearing_loss)) %>%
  distinct(hhidpn)
ids_excl_s4 <- ids_s3 %>% anti_join(ids_s4, by = "hhidpn")
dem_excl_s4 <- sum(all_ids %>% semi_join(ids_excl_s4, by = "hhidpn") %>% pull(ever_dem))

# Step 5: Non-missing vision_overall at baseline
ids_s5 <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  filter(year >= baseline_start, year <= baseline_end,
         !is.na(age), age >= 50,
         !is.na(dementia), dementia == 0,
         !is.na(hearing_loss),
         !is.na(vision_overall)) %>%
  distinct(hhidpn)
ids_excl_s5 <- ids_s4 %>% anti_join(ids_s5, by = "hhidpn")
dem_excl_s5 <- sum(all_ids %>% semi_join(ids_excl_s5, by = "hhidpn") %>% pull(ever_dem))

# Step 6: Non-missing Frailty_status at baseline
ids_s6 <- hrs_long_fixed %>%
  filter(year >= baseline_start, year <= baseline_end,
         !is.na(age), age >= 50,
         !is.na(dementia), dementia == 0,
         !is.na(hearing_loss),
         !is.na(vision_overall),
         !is.na(Frailty_status)) %>%
  distinct(hhidpn)
ids_excl_s6 <- ids_s5 %>% anti_join(ids_s6, by = "hhidpn")
dem_excl_s6 <- sum(all_ids %>% semi_join(ids_excl_s6, by = "hhidpn") %>% pull(ever_dem))

# Step 7: >= 2 waves of hearing + vision + frailty + dementia, has follow-up
ids_excl_s7 <- ids_s6 %>% anti_join(eligible_ids, by = "hhidpn")
dem_excl_s7 <- sum(all_ids %>% semi_join(ids_excl_s7, by = "hhidpn") %>% pull(ever_dem))

# Incident dementia
incident <- panel_df_eligible %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, year) %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_year  = first(baseline_year),
    last_year      = max(year),
    ever_dem       = max(dementia, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_dem_year = if (any(dementia == 1)) min(year[dementia == 1]) else NA_integer_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(incident = as.integer(ever_dem == 1 & first_dem_year > baseline_year))
n_incident <- sum(incident$incident)

# Print
cat("======================================================================\n")
cat("HRS — EXCLUSION FLOW (hearing + vision + frailty + dementia completeness)\n")
cat("======================================================================\n\n")

cat(sprintf("Step  %-60s  %7s  %7s  %s\n", "Criteria", "N", "Excl.", "Dem. lost"))
cat(paste(rep("-", 105), collapse = ""), "\n")

cat(sprintf("  0   %-60s  %7d  %7s  %d\n",
            "Total in hrs_long (after cummax)", n_total, "--", dem_total))
cat(sprintf("  1   %-60s  %7d  -%5d  %d\n",
            "With observation in 2004-2010", nrow(ids_s1), nrow(ids_excl_s1), dem_excl_s1))
cat(sprintf("  2   %-60s  %7d  -%5d  %d\n",
            "Age >= 50", nrow(ids_s2), nrow(ids_excl_s2), dem_excl_s2))
cat(sprintf("  3   %-60s  %7d  -%5d  %d (prevalent)\n",
            "Dementia-free at baseline", nrow(ids_s3), nrow(ids_excl_s3), dem_excl_s3))
cat(sprintf("  4   %-60s  %7d  -%5d  %d\n",
            "Non-missing hearing_loss at baseline", nrow(ids_s4), nrow(ids_excl_s4), dem_excl_s4))
cat(sprintf("  5   %-60s  %7d  -%5d  %d\n",
            "Non-missing vision_overall at baseline", nrow(ids_s5), nrow(ids_excl_s5), dem_excl_s5))
cat(sprintf("  6   %-60s  %7d  -%5d  %d\n",
            "Non-missing Frailty_status at baseline", nrow(ids_s6), nrow(ids_excl_s6), dem_excl_s6))
cat(sprintf("  7   %-60s  %7d  -%5d  %d\n",
            ">= 2 waves of all + has follow-up",
            nrow(eligible_ids), nrow(ids_excl_s7), dem_excl_s7))

cat(paste(rep("-", 105), collapse = ""), "\n")
cat(sprintf("      %-60s  %7d\n", "FINAL ANALYTIC COHORT", nrow(eligible_ids)))
cat(sprintf("      %-60s  %7d\n", "Incident dementia (after baseline)", n_incident))

```



# Table 1: HRS Baseline Characteristics
```{r}
# Table 1: HRS Baseline Characteristics
# ---------- Helper functions ----------
fmt_n          <- function(n) formatC(n, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
fmt_n_pct      <- function(n, total) sprintf("%s (%.1f)", fmt_n(n), 100 * n / total)
fmt_mean_sd    <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
fmt_mean_sd_2d <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
fmt_range      <- function(x) sprintf("%.0f-%.0f", min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE))

# ---------- Follow-up time and incident dementia ----------
# Person-time and incident dementia: censor at first dementia wave (or last observed wave)
fu_tbl <- panel_df_eligible %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, year) %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_year  = first(baseline_year),
    last_year      = max(year),
    ever_dem       = as.integer(any(dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    first_dem_year = if (any(dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE)) min(year[dementia == 1]) else NA_integer_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    incident       = as.integer(ever_dem == 1 & first_dem_year > baseline_year),
    end_year       = if_else(incident == 1, first_dem_year, last_year),
    followup_yrs   = as.numeric(end_year - baseline_year)
  )

N <- nrow(baseline_df_eligible)

# Incidence rate per 100 person-years
total_py        <- sum(fu_tbl$followup_yrs, na.rm = TRUE)
n_incident      <- sum(fu_tbl$incident == 1)
n_no_dementia   <- N - n_incident
incidence_rate  <- 100 * n_incident / total_py

# ---------- Pre-compute counts ----------
n_male     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Gender == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_female   <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Gender == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
n_white    <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Race == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_nonwhite <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Race == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_race_na  <- sum(is.na(baseline_df_eligible$Race))
n_nonfrail <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Frailty_status == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_frail    <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Frailty_status == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_edu0     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Education == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_edu1     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Education == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_edu2     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Education == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
n_mar0     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Marital_status == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_mar1     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Marital_status == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_emp0     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Employment == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_emp1     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Employment == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_smk0     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Smoking == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_smk1     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Smoking == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_alc0     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Alcohol == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_alc1     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Alcohol == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_pa0      <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Physical_activity == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_pa1      <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Physical_activity == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_sa0      <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Social_activity == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_sa1      <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$Social_activity == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_hear0    <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$hearing_loss == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_hear1    <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$hearing_loss == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
n_vis0     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$vision_overall == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
n_vis1     <- sum(baseline_df_eligible$vision_overall == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

# ---------- Console print ----------
cat("\n======================================================================\n")
cat("TABLE 1: Characteristics of analysed participants (HRS)\n")
cat("======================================================================\n\n")
cat(sprintf("%-60s  %s\n", "Characteristics", "HRS"))
cat(paste(rep("-", 80), collapse = ""), "\n")

cat(sprintf("%-60s  %s\n", "Total, n", fmt_n(N)))
cat(sprintf("%-60s  %s\n", "Age at baseline, years, mean (S.D.)", fmt_mean_sd(baseline_df_eligible$age)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Range", fmt_range(baseline_df_eligible$age)))

cat("\nGender, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Male",   fmt_n_pct(n_male, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Female", fmt_n_pct(n_female, N)))

cat("\nRace/ethnicity, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "White",     fmt_n_pct(n_white, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Non-white", fmt_n_pct(n_nonwhite, N)))
if (n_race_na > 0) cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Missing", fmt_n_pct(n_race_na, N)))

cat(sprintf("\n%-60s  %s\n", "Frailty index score, mean (S.D.)", fmt_mean_sd_2d(baseline_df_eligible$FI_score)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Non frail (score < 0.25), n (%)", fmt_n_pct(n_nonfrail, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Frail (score >= 0.25), n (%)",    fmt_n_pct(n_frail, N)))

cat("\nEducation, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Lower",        fmt_n_pct(n_edu0, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Intermediate", fmt_n_pct(n_edu1, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Higher",       fmt_n_pct(n_edu2, N)))

cat("\nMarital status, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Others (separated, divorced, widowed, or never married)", fmt_n_pct(n_mar0, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Married",                                                 fmt_n_pct(n_mar1, N)))

cat("\nEmployment, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Unemployment",                 fmt_n_pct(n_emp0, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Currently working or retired", fmt_n_pct(n_emp1, N)))

cat("\nSmoking status, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Never smoked",     fmt_n_pct(n_smk0, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Smoke at present", fmt_n_pct(n_smk1, N)))

cat("\nAlcohol consumption, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Never drink",       fmt_n_pct(n_alc0, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Any drinking days", fmt_n_pct(n_alc1, N)))

cat("\nPhysical activity, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Less active", fmt_n_pct(n_pa0, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "More active", fmt_n_pct(n_pa1, N)))

cat("\nSocial activity, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Not socially active", fmt_n_pct(n_sa0, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Socially active",     fmt_n_pct(n_sa1, N)))

cat("\nHearing impairment, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "No",  fmt_n_pct(n_hear0, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Yes", fmt_n_pct(n_hear1, N)))

cat("\nVision impairment, n (%)\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "No",  fmt_n_pct(n_vis0, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Yes", fmt_n_pct(n_vis1, N)))

cat("\nFollow-up\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Time, years, mean (S.D.)",   fmt_mean_sd(fu_tbl$followup_yrs)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "No dementia, n (%)",         fmt_n_pct(n_no_dementia, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %s\n", "Incident dementia, n (%)",   fmt_n_pct(n_incident, N)))
cat(sprintf("  %-58s  %.2f (%s)\n",
            "Dementia incidence rate per 100 person-years (total PY)",
            incidence_rate, fmt_n(round(total_py))))

cat(paste(rep("-", 80), collapse = ""), "\n")

# ---------- Tidy data frame for export ----------
table1_df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Characteristic,                                               ~HRS,
  "Total, n",                                                    fmt_n(N),
  "Age at baseline, years, mean (S.D.)",                         fmt_mean_sd(baseline_df_eligible$age),
  "  Range",                                                     fmt_range(baseline_df_eligible$age),
  "Gender - Male",                                               fmt_n_pct(n_male, N),
  "Gender - Female",                                             fmt_n_pct(n_female, N),
  "Race/ethnicity - White",                                      fmt_n_pct(n_white, N),
  "Race/ethnicity - Non-white",                                  fmt_n_pct(n_nonwhite, N),
  "Frailty index score, mean (S.D.)",                            fmt_mean_sd_2d(baseline_df_eligible$FI_score),
  "  Non frail (score < 0.25)",                                  fmt_n_pct(n_nonfrail, N),
  "  Frail (score >= 0.25)",                                     fmt_n_pct(n_frail, N),
  "Education - Lower",                                           fmt_n_pct(n_edu0, N),
  "Education - Intermediate",                                    fmt_n_pct(n_edu1, N),
  "Education - Higher",                                          fmt_n_pct(n_edu2, N),
  "Marital status - Others",                                     fmt_n_pct(n_mar0, N),
  "Marital status - Married",                                    fmt_n_pct(n_mar1, N),
  "Employment - Unemployment",                                   fmt_n_pct(n_emp0, N),
  "Employment - Currently working or retired",                   fmt_n_pct(n_emp1, N),
  "Smoking - Never smoked",                                      fmt_n_pct(n_smk0, N),
  "Smoking - Smoke at present",                                  fmt_n_pct(n_smk1, N),
  "Alcohol - Never drink",                                       fmt_n_pct(n_alc0, N),
  "Alcohol - Any drinking days",                                 fmt_n_pct(n_alc1, N),
  "Physical activity - Less active",                             fmt_n_pct(n_pa0, N),
  "Physical activity - More active",                             fmt_n_pct(n_pa1, N),
  "Social activity - Not socially active",                       fmt_n_pct(n_sa0, N),
  "Social activity - Socially active",                           fmt_n_pct(n_sa1, N),
  "Hearing impairment - No",                                     fmt_n_pct(n_hear0, N),
  "Hearing impairment - Yes",                                    fmt_n_pct(n_hear1, N),
  "Vision impairment - No",                                      fmt_n_pct(n_vis0, N),
  "Vision impairment - Yes",                                     fmt_n_pct(n_vis1, N),
  "Follow-up - Time, years, mean (S.D.)",                        fmt_mean_sd(fu_tbl$followup_yrs),
  "Follow-up - No dementia",                                     fmt_n_pct(n_no_dementia, N),
  "Follow-up - Incident dementia",                               fmt_n_pct(n_incident, N),
  "Dementia incidence rate per 100 person-years",                sprintf("%.2f (%s PY)", incidence_rate, fmt_n(round(total_py)))
)

print(table1_df, n = Inf)


# ======================================================================
# Table 2: Baseline Year Distribution with Incident Dementia
# ======================================================================

table2 <- incident_tbl %>%
  group_by(baseline_year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    n_incident     = sum(incident),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_cohort    = round(100 * n_participants / sum(n_participants), 1),
    pct_incident  = round(100 * n_incident / sum(n_incident), 1),
    incidence_pct = round(100 * n_incident / n_participants, 2)
  )

total_row <- tibble(
  baseline_year  = NA_integer_,
  n_participants = sum(table2$n_participants),
  n_incident     = sum(table2$n_incident),
  pct_cohort     = 100,
  pct_incident   = 100,
  incidence_pct  = round(100 * sum(table2$n_incident) / sum(table2$n_participants), 2)
)

table2_full <- bind_rows(table2, total_row) %>%
  mutate(baseline_year = if_else(is.na(baseline_year), "Total", as.character(baseline_year)))

cat("\n======================================================================\n")
cat("TABLE 2: Baseline Year Distribution with Incident Dementia\n")
cat("======================================================================\n\n")

cat(sprintf("%-15s  %15s  %15s  %15s  %15s\n",
            "Baseline Year", "Participants (n)", "% of Cohort", "Incident (n)", "% of Incidents"))
cat(paste(rep("-", 85), collapse = ""), "\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(table2_full))) {
  row <- table2_full[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-15s  %15s  %14.1f%%  %15s  %14.1f%%\n",
              row$baseline_year,
              format(row$n_participants, big.mark = ","),
              row$pct_cohort,
              format(row$n_incident, big.mark = ","),
              row$pct_incident))
}

cat("\nNote: 2004 entrants dominate the cohort and contribute the majority of incident\n")
cat("dementia cases, reflecting their longer follow-up window (up to 16 years).\n\n")

print(table2_full, n = Inf)

write.csv(baseline_df_eligible,
          file = "hrs_baseline.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(panel_df_eligible,
          file = "hrs_panel.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# msm for hearing loss, frailty, and dementia (HRS — 8-state model with death)
```{r}
# 1) Build interview-based dataset with time since baseline (NO age)
ms_base <- panel_df_eligible %>%
  mutate(
    hhidpn        = as.character(hhidpn),
    year          = as.integer(year),
    baseline_year = as.integer(baseline_year),
    int_date      = ymd(paste0(year,          "-06-15")),
    baseline_date = ymd(paste0(baseline_year, "-06-15")),
    time          = as.numeric(difftime(int_date, baseline_date,
                                        units = "days")) / 365.25
  ) %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, time)

# 2) Compute death_time per person (years since baseline)
death_tbl <- ms_base %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_date = first(baseline_date),
    death_date    = first(death_date),
    died          = first(died),
    death_time    = ifelse(
      !is.na(death_date),
      as.numeric(difftime(death_date, baseline_date, units = "days")) / 365.25,
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_time = ifelse(!is.na(death_time) & death_time >= 0, death_time, NA_real_)
  )

# 3) Append ONE death row per decedent at exact death_time
death_rows <- death_tbl %>%
  filter(died == 1, !is.na(death_time)) %>%
  transmute(
    hhidpn,
    time  = death_time,
    state = 8L
  )

# 4) Construct clinical states (1-7) on interview rows
ms_states <- ms_base %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  mutate(
    t_hl  = if (any(hearing_loss   == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
              min(time[hearing_loss   == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    t_f   = if (any(Frailty_status == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
              min(time[Frailty_status == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    t_dem = if (any(dementia       == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
              min(time[dementia       == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,

    order_type = case_when(
      !is.na(t_hl) & !is.na(t_f) & t_hl <  t_f  ~ "HL_first",
      !is.na(t_hl) & !is.na(t_f) & t_f  <  t_hl ~ "Frail_first",
      !is.na(t_hl) & !is.na(t_f) & t_hl == t_f  ~ "Simultaneous",
      TRUE                                       ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    state = case_when(
      # 7 = Dementia (highest priority — terminal)
      !is.na(t_dem) & time >= t_dem                                     ~ 7L,
      # 6 = HL + frailty simultaneous
      order_type == "Simultaneous" & !is.na(t_hl) & time >= t_hl        ~ 6L,
      # 4 = HL first, then frailty
      order_type == "HL_first"     & !is.na(t_f)  & time >= t_f         ~ 4L,
      # 5 = Frailty first, then HL
      order_type == "Frail_first"  & !is.na(t_hl) & time >= t_hl        ~ 5L,
      # 2 = Hearing loss only
      !is.na(t_hl) & time >= t_hl & (is.na(t_f)  | time < t_f)          ~ 2L,
      # 3 = Frailty only
      !is.na(t_f)  & time >= t_f  & (is.na(t_hl) | time < t_hl)         ~ 3L,
      # 1 = Healthy
      TRUE                                                              ~ 1L
    ),
    state = as.integer(state)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, time, state)


# 5) Combine interview states with death rows
# 6) Truncate follow-up AFTER death (death is absorbing); keep persons with >=2 obs
ms_dat <- bind_rows(ms_states, death_rows) %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, time) %>%
  group_by(hhidpn, time) %>%
  slice(1) %>%                                  # collapse duplicates at same t
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  mutate(
    first_absorb_time = if (any(state %in% c(7L, 8L)))
                          min(time[state %in% c(7L, 8L)]) else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(first_absorb_time) | time <= first_absorb_time) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, time, state)

```



# 8-state msm: fit model
```{r}
# Q matrix (8 x 8) — only structural pattern matters when gen.inits = TRUE
# Permitted transitions:
#   1 Healthy             -> 2, 3, 6, 7, 8
#   2 HL only             -> 4, 7, 8
#   3 Frailty only        -> 5, 7, 8
#   4 Both (HL-first)     -> 7, 8
#   5 Both (Frail-first)  -> 7, 8
#   6 Both (Simultaneous) -> 7, 8
#   7 Dementia            absorbing (NO outgoing — row 7 all zeros)
#   8 Death               absorbing (NO outgoing — row 8 all zeros)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Q <- matrix(0, 8, 8)

# From Healthy (1)
Q[1, 2] <- 0.10; Q[1, 3] <- 0.10; Q[1, 6] <- 0.05; Q[1, 7] <- 0.02; Q[1, 8] <- 0.05
# From HL only (2)
Q[2, 4] <- 0.10; Q[2, 7] <- 0.02; Q[2, 8] <- 0.05
# From Frailty only (3)
Q[3, 5] <- 0.10; Q[3, 7] <- 0.02; Q[3, 8] <- 0.05
# From Both HL-first (4)
Q[4, 7] <- 0.05; Q[4, 8] <- 0.05
# From Both Frailty-first (5)
Q[5, 7] <- 0.05; Q[5, 8] <- 0.05
# From Both Simultaneous (6)
Q[6, 7] <- 0.05; Q[6, 8] <- 0.05
# Rows 7 and 8 left as zeros => absorbing

diag(Q) <- NA

# Fit HEARING model
fit_hearing <- msm(state ~ time,
                   subject  = hhidpn, data = ms_dat,
                   qmatrix  = Q,
                   gen.inits = TRUE,
                   control  = list(fnscale = 5000, maxit = 5000))

# ---- Diagnostics ----
Q_est <- qmatrix.msm(fit_hearing);                                 print(Q_est)
transition_count <- statetable.msm(state, hhidpn, data = ms_dat);  print(transition_count)

# Transition rate ratios
ratio_first_hear  <- qratio.msm(fit_hearing, ind1 = c(1, 3), ind2 = c(1, 2))
rr_sensory_dem    <- qratio.msm(fit_hearing, ind1 = c(4, 7), ind2 = c(2, 7))
rr_frailty_dem    <- qratio.msm(fit_hearing, ind1 = c(5, 7), ind2 = c(3, 7))
rr_sim_vs_sensory <- qratio.msm(fit_hearing, ind1 = c(6, 7), ind2 = c(2, 7))
rr_sim_vs_frailty <- qratio.msm(fit_hearing, ind1 = c(6, 7), ind2 = c(3, 7))

print(ratio_first_hear)
print(rr_sensory_dem)
print(rr_frailty_dem)
print(rr_sim_vs_sensory)
print(rr_sim_vs_frailty)

# ============================================================
# Transition probability matrices at 5 and 10 years

P5  <- pmatrix.msm(fit_hearing, t = 5)
P10 <- pmatrix.msm(fit_hearing, t = 10)
cat("\n=== Transition probabilities at t = 5 years ===\n");  print(P5)
cat("\n=== Transition probabilities at t = 10 years ===\n"); print(P10)

```




```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(ggalluvial)

# PANEL A — Heatmap
# Drop ABSORBING origin rows (Dementia, Death). Keep them as destination cols.
# ============================================================================
make_state_levels <- function(sense_word) {
  c(
    "Healthy",
    paste(sense_word, "impairment only"),
    "Frailty only",
    paste0("Both (", sense_word, "-first)"),
    "Both (Frail-first)",
    "Both (Simultaneous)",
    "Dementia",
    "Death"
  )
}

mat_to_long_local <- function(P, time_label, state_levels_local) {
  P <- as.matrix(P)
  dimnames(P) <- list(state_levels_local, state_levels_local)
  df <- as.data.frame.table(P, responseName = "prob")
  names(df)[1:2] <- c("from", "to")
  df %>%
    mutate(
      time = factor(time_label, levels = c("5 years", "10 years")),
      from = factor(from, levels = state_levels_local),
      to   = factor(to,   levels = state_levels_local)
    )
}

build_heatmap <- function(P5_mat, P10_mat, model_label, sense_word) {
  state_lvl   <- make_state_levels(sense_word)
  absorb_lvls <- state_lvl[7:8]                # Dementia + Death
  data <- bind_rows(
    mat_to_long_local(P5_mat,  "5 years",  state_lvl),
    mat_to_long_local(P10_mat, "10 years", state_lvl)
  ) %>%
    filter(!from %in% absorb_lvls) %>%         # <-- drop trivial absorbing rows
    mutate(
      from  = droplevels(from),                # keep y-axis tidy
      model = factor(model_label, levels = model_label)
    )

  # --- position of the Dementia column + number of origin rows (for the highlight) ---
  dem_x  <- which(levels(data$to) == "Dementia")
  n_from <- nlevels(droplevels(data$from))

  ggplot(data, aes(x = to, y = fct_rev(from), fill = prob)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label  = ifelse(prob >= 0.005, sprintf("%.2f", prob), ""),
                  colour = prob > 0.5),
              size = 3.4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "grey15"),
                        guide  = "none") +
    # --- highlight the Dementia destination column ---
    annotate("rect",
             xmin = dem_x - 0.5, xmax = dem_x + 0.5,
             ymin = 0.5,         ymax = n_from + 0.5,
             fill = NA, colour = "#D55E00", linewidth = 1.1) +
    facet_grid(model ~ time, switch = "y") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#FFFFFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1",
                  "#4292C6", "#08519C", "#08306B"),
      limits  = c(0, 1),
      breaks  = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
      name    = "Transition\nprobability",
      guide   = guide_colorbar(barwidth = 0.8, barheight = 11,
                               frame.colour = "grey40",
                               ticks.colour = "grey40")
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    labs(x = "Destination state", y = "Starting state") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 11),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      strip.text       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      strip.placement  = "outside",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
      panel.spacing    = unit(0.6, "cm"),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compose Panel A (hearing + vision)
# Requires: fit_vision, P5_vis, P10_vis from the parallel vision pipeline
# (same code as above with vision_loss replacing hearing_loss).
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
panel_A_hearing <- build_heatmap(P5,     P10,     "Hearing model", "Hearing")
panel_A_vision  <- build_heatmap(P5_vis, P10_vis, "Vision model",  "Vision")

panel_A <- panel_A_hearing / panel_A_vision +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "a.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0),
      plot.title.position = "plot"            # anchor "a." to the far-left edge
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

# 8-state msm: fit model
```{r}
# Q matrix (8 x 8) — identical structural template to the hearing model
# Permitted transitions:
#   1 Healthy             -> 2, 3, 6, 7, 8
#   2 VL only             -> 4, 7, 8
#   3 Frailty only        -> 5, 7, 8
#   4 Both (VL-first)     -> 7, 8
#   5 Both (Frail-first)  -> 7, 8
#   6 Both (Simultaneous) -> 7, 8
#   7 Dementia            absorbing (NO outgoing)
#   8 Death               absorbing (NO outgoing)

Q_vis <- matrix(0, 8, 8)

# From Healthy (1)
Q_vis[1, 2] <- 0.10
Q_vis[1, 3] <- 0.10
Q_vis[1, 6] <- 0.05
Q_vis[1, 7] <- 0.02
Q_vis[1, 8] <- 0.05

# From VL only (2)
Q_vis[2, 4] <- 0.10
Q_vis[2, 7] <- 0.02
Q_vis[2, 8] <- 0.05

# From Frailty only (3)
Q_vis[3, 5] <- 0.10
Q_vis[3, 7] <- 0.02
Q_vis[3, 8] <- 0.05

# From Both VL-first (4)
Q_vis[4, 7] <- 0.05
Q_vis[4, 8] <- 0.05

# From Both Frailty-first (5)
Q_vis[5, 7] <- 0.05
Q_vis[5, 8] <- 0.05

# From Both Simultaneous (6)
Q_vis[6, 7] <- 0.05
Q_vis[6, 8] <- 0.05

# Rows 7 (Dementia) and 8 (Death) left as zeros => absorbing

diag(Q_vis) <- NA

# Fit VISION model
fit_vision <- msm(
  state ~ time,
  subject  = hhidpn,
  data     = ms_dat_vis,
  qmatrix  = Q_vis,
  gen.inits = TRUE,
  control  = list(fnscale = 5000, maxit = 3000)
)

# ---- Diagnostics ----
Q_est_vis <- qmatrix.msm(fit_vision)
print(Q_est_vis)

transition_count_vis <- statetable.msm(state, hhidpn, data = ms_dat_vis)
print(transition_count_vis)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Transition rate ratios
# Healthy -> Frailty vs Healthy -> Vision loss
ratio_first_vis <- qratio.msm(
  fit_vision,
  ind1 = c(1, 3),
  ind2 = c(1, 2)
)

# (A) Vision pathway: Co-occur (vision first) -> Dementia  vs  Vision only -> Dementia
rr_vision_dem <- qratio.msm(
  fit_vision,
  ind1 = c(4, 7),
  ind2 = c(2, 7)
)

# (B) Frailty pathway: Co-occur (frailty first) -> Dementia  vs  Frailty only -> Dementia
rr_frailty_dem_vis <- qratio.msm(
  fit_vision,
  ind1 = c(5, 7),
  ind2 = c(3, 7)
)

# (C) Simultaneous co-occurrence vs single states
rr_sim_vs_vision      <- qratio.msm(fit_vision, ind1 = c(6, 7), ind2 = c(2, 7))
rr_sim_vs_frailty_vis <- qratio.msm(fit_vision, ind1 = c(6, 7), ind2 = c(3, 7))

print(ratio_first_vis)
print(rr_vision_dem)
print(rr_frailty_dem_vis)
print(rr_sim_vs_vision)
print(rr_sim_vs_frailty_vis)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Transition probability matrices at 5 and 10 years
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
P5_vis  <- pmatrix.msm(fit_vision, t = 5)
P10_vis <- pmatrix.msm(fit_vision, t = 10)
cat("\n=== Vision: Transition probabilities at t = 5 years ===\n");  print(P5_vis)
cat("\n=== Vision: Transition probabilities at t = 10 years ===\n"); print(P10_vis)
```

# Cox models (model 1,2,3,4) for hearing loss and vision loss (HRS)
```{r}
library(survival)

# Time-invariant covariates from baseline (includes baseline age)
baseline_invariant <- baseline_df_eligible %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(hhidpn, Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, age) %>%
  rename(baseline_age = age)

df0 <- panel_df_eligible %>%
  mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Gender, -Race, -Education, -Marital_status) %>%
  left_join(baseline_invariant, by = "hhidpn") %>%
  mutate(
    year          = as.integer(year),
    baseline_year = as.integer(baseline_year),
    time          = as.numeric(year - baseline_year),

    # outcome (binary)
    dementia       = as.integer(dementia),

    # binary exposures stay integer 0/1
    hearing_loss   = as.integer(hearing_loss),
    vision_overall = as.integer(vision_overall),
    Frailty_status = as.integer(Frailty_status), 

    # categorical exposures/covariates -> factors
    Employment     = factor(Employment),
    Smoking        = factor(Smoking),
    Alcohol        = factor(Alcohol),
    Gender         = factor(Gender),
    Race           = factor(Race),
    Education      = factor(Education),
    Marital_status = factor(Marital_status),

    baseline_age   = as.numeric(baseline_age)
  ) %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, time)

# 1) Build interval dataset (counting-process format)
tv_dat <- df0 %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  mutate(
    tstart      = lag(time),
    tstop       = time,
    event       = dementia,

    # status at the START of the interval
    hearing_lag = lag(hearing_loss),
    vision_lag  = lag(vision_overall),
    frailty_lag = lag(Frailty_status),

    emp_lag     = lag(Employment),
    smoke_lag   = lag(Smoking),
    alcohol_lag = lag(Alcohol)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(tstart), tstop > tstart)

# 2) Keep intervals up to first dementia event
tv_dat <- tv_dat %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  mutate(event_cum = cumsum(event)) %>%
  filter(event_cum <= 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-event_cum)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Common analytic sample (complete-case on the M4 covariate set)
#    Using the same rows for M1-M4 makes HRs across models comparable.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
tv_cc <- tv_dat %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(hearing_lag), !is.na(vision_lag), !is.na(frailty_lag),
    !is.na(emp_lag),    !is.na(smoke_lag),  !is.na(alcohol_lag),
    !is.na(baseline_age),
    !is.na(Gender), !is.na(Race), !is.na(Education), !is.na(Marital_status)
  )

cat("Analytic intervals:", nrow(tv_cc),
    " | unique persons:", dplyr::n_distinct(tv_cc$hhidpn),
    " | events:", sum(tv_cc$event), "\n")

# ======================================================================
# Helper: tidy HR table
# ======================================================================
tidy_hr <- function(fit, terms = NULL, model_label = NA_character_) {
  out <- broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(term, HR = estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
    mutate(
      HR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", HR, conf.low, conf.high),
      model = model_label
    )
  if (!is.null(terms)) out <- out %>% filter(term %in% terms)
  out
}

# Helper: print N / events for each fit
fit_n <- function(fit, label) {
  cat(sprintf("[%s]  n = %d   events = %d\n",
              label, fit$n, fit$nevent))
}

# ======================================================================
# Pre-flight checks (still useful — applies to the supplementary mutual model)
# ======================================================================
prev_tab <- tv_cc %>%
  count(hearing_lag, vision_lag, frailty_lag) %>%
```

# Model 5 Hearing loss and vision los vs frailty
```{r}
make_midyear_date <- function(y) ymd(paste0(as.integer(y), "-06-15"))

# Model 5 — Hearing/Vision × Frailty timing → incident dementia (HRS)
# Time-varying, state-based classification (no future-information leakage)
#
# Exposure categories (at each interval ending at `stop`):
#   0 = No sensory impairment                              (reference)
#   1 = Sensory impairment present, frailty not yet onset by `stop`
#   2 = Sensory impairment present, frailty already onset at or before `stop`
# ==========================================================================

build_m5_dataset <- function(panel_df, baseline_df,
                             sensory_var, sensory_label) {

  # ---- 1) Time scale, person-level onsets, NA-preserving tv indicators ---
  df_tv <- panel_df %>%
    mutate(
      hhidpn        = as.character(hhidpn),
      year          = as.integer(year),
      baseline_year = as.integer(baseline_year),
      int_date      = make_midyear_date(year),
      baseline_date = make_midyear_date(baseline_year),
      time          = as.numeric(difftime(int_date, baseline_date,
                                          units = "days")) / 365.25,
      .sensory      = .data[[sensory_var]]
    ) %>%
    arrange(hhidpn, time) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(
      sensory_onset_time = if (any(.sensory == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[.sensory == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
                           else NA_real_,
      frailty_onset_time = if (any(Frailty_status == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[Frailty_status == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
                           else NA_real_,
      dem_time           = if (any(dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[dementia == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
                           else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      sensory_tv = dplyr::if_else(.sensory == 1, 1L, 0L)
    )

  # ---- 2) Intervals + 3-level state context + lags (pre-filter) ----------
  df_tv <- df_tv %>%
    arrange(hhidpn, time) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(
      start = lag(time),
      stop  = time,

      dementia_event = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(dem_time) & stop == dem_time,
                                      1L, 0L),

      # "frailty already onset" treats frailty as absorbing for the context
      # variable, consistent with Methods: "concurrent or prior frailty".
      frailty_by_stop = !is.na(frailty_onset_time) & frailty_onset_time <= stop,

      # 3-level: reference = no sensory impairment (any frailty status)
      ctx_tv = case_when(
        sensory_tv == 0                     ~ 0L,   # No sensory impairment (ref)
        sensory_tv == 1 & !frailty_by_stop  ~ 1L,   # Sensory, no frailty yet
        sensory_tv == 1 &  frailty_by_stop  ~ 2L,   # Sensory, frailty present
        TRUE                                ~ NA_integer_
      ),

      ctx_lag     = lag(ctx_tv),
      emp_lag     = lag(Employment),
      smoke_lag   = lag(Smoking),
      alcohol_lag = lag(Alcohol)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # ---- 3) Filter ---------------------------------------------------------
  df_tv <- df_tv %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(start),
      stop > start,
      is.na(dem_time) | start < dem_time,
      !is.na(ctx_lag)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ctx_lag = factor(
        ctx_lag,
        levels = c(0, 1, 2),
        labels = c(paste0("No ", sensory_label, " (ref)"),
                   paste0(sensory_label, ", no frailty yet"),
                   paste0(sensory_label, ", frailty present"))
      ),
      # ensure lagged categorical covariates are clean factors
      emp_lag     = droplevels(factor(emp_lag)),
      smoke_lag   = droplevels(factor(smoke_lag)),
      alcohol_lag = droplevels(factor(alcohol_lag))
    )

  # ---- 4) Attach baseline-invariant covariates ---------------------------
  baseline_invariant <- baseline_df %>%
    dplyr::select(hhidpn, Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, age) %>%
    rename(baseline_age = age) %>%
    mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn))

  df_tv <- df_tv %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("Gender", "Race", "Education", "Marital_status"))) %>%
    left_join(baseline_invariant, by = "hhidpn") %>%
    mutate(
      baseline_age   = as.numeric(baseline_age),
      # FIX: keep these as factors (NOT as.integer) so each level gets its
      # own dummy in the Cox model. This matches Models 1-4 and avoids
      # forcing a linear contrast on 3-level Education.
      Gender         = droplevels(factor(Gender)),
      Race           = droplevels(factor(Race)),
      Education      = droplevels(factor(Education)),
      Marital_status = droplevels(factor(Marital_status))
    )

  stopifnot(
    !any(df_tv$start >= df_tv$stop),
    !any(is.na(df_tv$ctx_lag))
  )

  df_tv
}

# ==========================================================================
# Helper: fit Model 5
# ==========================================================================
fit_m5 <- function(dat, label) {
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat(label, "Model 5 (3-level, reference = No sensory impairment)\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat("Intervals:", nrow(dat),
      "| Events:",  sum(dat$dementia_event),
      "| People:",  dplyr::n_distinct(dat$hhidpn), "\n\n")

  cat("Category distribution (lagged, interval-level):\n")
  print(table(dat$ctx_lag, useNA = "ifany"))

  cat("\nEvents by category:\n")
  print(
    dat %>%
      group_by(ctx_lag) %>%
      summarise(intervals = n(), events = sum(dementia_event),
                .groups = "drop")
  )

  fit <- coxph(
    Surv(start, stop, dementia_event) ~
      ctx_lag + baseline_age +
      Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
      emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag,
    data = dat, cluster = hhidpn, ties = "efron", na.action = na.omit
  )

  cat("\n--- Cox fit ---\n")
  print(summary(fit))
  cat("\n--- PH check ---\n")
  print(cox.zph(fit))
  fit
}

# ==========================================================================
# Helper: contrast HR(sensory + frailty) vs. HR(sensory, no frailty yet)
# ==========================================================================
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty <- function(fit, label) {
  co <- coef(fit)
  vc <- vcov(fit)
  i_no_fr  <- grep("no frailty yet",  names(co))
  i_fr_yes <- grep("frailty present", names(co))

  L <- numeric(length(co))
  L[i_fr_yes] <-  1
  L[i_no_fr]  <- -1

  est <- sum(L * co)
  se  <- sqrt(t(L) %*% vc %*% L)[1, 1]
  z   <- est / se
  p   <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n[%s] log-HR(frailty present) - log-HR(no frailty yet) = %.3f (SE %.3f), z = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
    label, est, se, z, p
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "  Ratio of HRs (frailty present / no frailty yet) = %.2f (95%% CI %.2f-%.2f)\n",
    exp(est), exp(est - 1.96 * se), exp(est + 1.96 * se)
  ))
  invisible(list(estimate = est, se = se, p = p,
                 ratio = exp(est),
                 ci = exp(est + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * se)))
}

# ==========================================================================
# Helper: person-level descriptive trajectory
# ==========================================================================
build_person_level <- function(panel_df, sensory_var, sensory_label) {
  panel_df %>%
    mutate(
      hhidpn        = as.character(hhidpn),
      year          = as.integer(year),
      baseline_year = as.integer(baseline_year),
      time          = as.numeric(year - baseline_year),
      .sensory      = .data[[sensory_var]]
    ) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    summarise(
      sensory_onset_time = if (any(.sensory == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[.sensory == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
                           else NA_real_,
      frailty_onset_time = if (any(Frailty_status == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[Frailty_status == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
                           else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      context = case_when(
        is.na(sensory_onset_time) ~
          paste0("No ", sensory_label),
        is.na(frailty_onset_time) | sensory_onset_time < frailty_onset_time ~
          paste0(sensory_label, " before frailty"),
        sensory_onset_time >= frailty_onset_time ~
          paste0(sensory_label, " with/after frailty")
      )
    )
}

# ==========================================================================
# 1) Build datasets
# ==========================================================================
df_tv_hearing <- build_m5_dataset(
  panel_df      = panel_df_eligible,
  baseline_df   = baseline_df_eligible,
  sensory_var   = "hearing_loss",
  sensory_label = "Hearing loss"
)

df_tv_vision <- build_m5_dataset(
  panel_df      = panel_df_eligible,
  baseline_df   = baseline_df_eligible,
  sensory_var   = "vision_overall",
  sensory_label = "Vision loss"
)

# ==========================================================================
# 2) Fit Model 5
# ==========================================================================
fit_m5_hearing <- fit_m5(df_tv_hearing, "HEARING")
summary(fit_m5_hearing)

fit_m5_vision  <- fit_m5(df_tv_vision,  "VISION")
summary(fit_m5_vision)

# ==========================================================================
# 3) Within-exposed contrast
# ==========================================================================
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty(fit_m5_hearing, "HEARING")
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty(fit_m5_vision,  "VISION")

# ==========================================================================
# 4) Person-level descriptives
# ==========================================================================
person_hearing <- build_person_level(panel_df_eligible, "hearing_loss",   "Hearing loss")
person_vision  <- build_person_level(panel_df_eligible, "vision_overall", "Vision loss")

cat("\nPerson-level trajectory - HEARING:\n")
print(table(person_hearing$context, useNA = "ifany"))

print(table(person_vision$context, useNA = "ifany"))
```

# PAF — Hearing Loss, Vision Loss, Frailty (HRS)
```{r}
# PAF for Models 1-5 (HRS, dementia outcome)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Models 1-4 use tv_cc (counting-process: tstart/tstop, *_lag exposures).
# Model 5 uses df_tv_hearing / df_tv_vision (start/stop, ctx_lag factor).
# Prevalence = person-time-weighted within each fit's analytic dataset.

set.seed(20260509)

# ---- Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
paf_binary_fn <- function(p, HR) (p * (HR - 1)) / (p * (HR - 1) + 1)

paf_ci_binary <- function(fit, term, p, nsim = 10000) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[term])
  V <- vcov(fit)[term, term]
  stopifnot(!is.na(b), V > 0)
  sims <- rnorm(nsim, mean = b, sd = sqrt(V))
  pafs <- paf_binary_fn(p, exp(sims))
  tibble(
    HR  = exp(b),
    PAF = paf_binary_fn(p, exp(b)),
    lcl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    ucl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

paf_ci_multicat <- function(fit, terms, p_vec, labels, nsim = 10000) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[terms])
  V <- vcov(fit)[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  sims <- MASS::mvrnorm(nsim, mu = b, Sigma = V)
  if (is.vector(sims)) sims <- matrix(sims, ncol = length(terms))
  HRs <- exp(sims)
  comp_mat <- sweep(HRs - 1, 2, p_vec, `*`)
  s_all    <- rowSums(comp_mat)
  paf_total_sim <- s_all / (1 + s_all)
  paf_comp_sim  <- comp_mat / (1 + s_all)

  HR_est    <- exp(b)
  comp_est  <- p_vec * (HR_est - 1)
  s_all_est <- sum(comp_est)

  tibble(
    component = c("Total", labels),
    HR        = c(NA_real_, HR_est),
    PAF       = c(s_all_est / (1 + s_all_est),
                  comp_est  / (1 + s_all_est)),
    lcl       = c(unname(quantile(paf_total_sim, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  apply(paf_comp_sim, 2,
                        function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)))),
    ucl       = c(unname(quantile(paf_total_sim, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  apply(paf_comp_sim, 2,
                        function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))))
  )
}

# Person-time-weighted prevalence (binary 0/1 indicator)
prev_pt_binary <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x  <- dat[[var]]
  sum(pt[x == 1], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Person-time-weighted prevalence per factor level
prev_pt_factor <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt    <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x     <- dat[[var]]
  total <- sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    level = levels(x),
    p     = vapply(levels(x),
                   function(lv) sum(pt[x == lv], na.rm = TRUE) / total,
                   numeric(1))
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# A) Person-time prevalences in tv_cc (Models 1-4)
# ============================================================================
p_hearing_14 <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", "tstart", "tstop")
p_vision_14  <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc, "vision_lag",  "tstart", "tstop")
p_frailty_14 <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc, "frailty_lag", "tstart", "tstop")

cat("Person-time-weighted prevalence (tv_cc):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Hearing loss : %.4f\n", p_hearing_14))
cat(sprintf("  Vision loss  : %.4f\n", p_vision_14))
cat(sprintf("  Frailty      : %.4f\n", p_frailty_14))

# ============================================================================
# B) PAF for Models 1-4 (each exposure paired with its own model fit)
# ============================================================================
paf_row <- function(fit, term, p, model_label, exposure_label) {
  res <- paf_ci_binary(fit, term, p)
  tibble(
    model    = model_label,
    exposure = exposure_label,
    p_pt     = p,
    HR       = res$HR,
    PAF      = res$PAF,
    PAF_lcl  = res$lcl,
    PAF_ucl  = res$ucl
  )
}

paf_models_1_4 <- bind_rows(
  # Model 1 (unadjusted)
  paf_row(fit_m1_hearing, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14, "M1 (unadjusted)",          "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m1_vision,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14,  "M1 (unadjusted)",          "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m1_frailty, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14, "M1 (unadjusted)",          "Frailty"),

  # Model 2 (+ sociodemographic)
  paf_row(fit_m2_hearing, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14, "M2 (+ age)",  "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m2_vision,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14,  "M2 (+ age)",  "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m2_frailty, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14, "M2 (+ age)",  "Frailty"),

  # Model 3 (+ lifestyle)
  paf_row(fit_m3_hearing, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14, "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)",         "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m3_vision,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14,  "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)",         "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m3_frailty, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14, "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)",         "Frailty"),

  # Model 4 (PRIMARY, hybrid: hearing/vision adjusted for frailty;
  # frailty from mutually-adjusted Cox)
  paf_row(fit_m4_hearing, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14, "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj)", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m4_vision,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14,  "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj)", "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m4_frailty, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14, "M4 (mutually adjusted)",   "Frailty")
)

cat("\n--- PAF: Models 1-4 ---\n")
print(paf_models_1_4, n = Inf)

# ============================================================================
# C) PAF for Model 5 (3-level ctx_lag, hearing and vision separately)
#    Component PAFs for each non-reference level + total PAF
# ============================================================================
paf_model5 <- function(fit, dat, model_label) {
  stopifnot(is.factor(dat$ctx_lag))
  ctx_levels   <- levels(dat$ctx_lag)
  ref_lvl      <- ctx_levels[1]
  exposed_lvls <- ctx_levels[-1]

  prev_tab  <- prev_pt_factor(dat, "ctx_lag", "start", "stop")
  p_exposed <- setNames(prev_tab$p[match(exposed_lvls, prev_tab$level)],
                        exposed_lvls)
  stopifnot(all(!is.na(p_exposed)), all(p_exposed > 0))

  terms <- paste0("ctx_lag", exposed_lvls)
  miss  <- setdiff(terms, names(coef(fit)))
  if (length(miss))
    stop("Missing coefficients in Model 5 fit: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  tab <- paf_ci_multicat(fit, terms, p_exposed, exposed_lvls)
  tab %>%
    mutate(
      model    = model_label,
      exposure = component,
      p_pt     = c(NA_real_, unname(p_exposed))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl = lcl, PAF_ucl = ucl)
}

paf_m5_hearing <- paf_model5(fit_m5_hearing, df_tv_hearing, "M5 (hearing context)")
paf_m5_vision  <- paf_model5(fit_m5_vision,  df_tv_vision,  "M5 (vision context)")

cat("\n--- PAF: Model 5 hearing context ---\n");  print(paf_m5_hearing, n = Inf)
cat("\n--- PAF: Model 5 vision context ---\n");   print(paf_m5_vision,  n = Inf)

# ============================================================================
# D) Combined summary
# ============================================================================
paf_all <- bind_rows(paf_models_1_4, paf_m5_hearing, paf_m5_vision) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI  = ifelse(is.na(HR), NA_character_,
                    sprintf("%.2f", HR)),
    PAF_CI = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",
                     100 * PAF, 100 * PAF_lcl, 100 * PAF_ucl)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl, PAF_CI)

cat("\n=== Combined PAF summary (Models 1-5) ===\n")
print(paf_all, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
    last_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t_event = ifelse(
      event == 1,
      event_year - baseline_year,
      last_year - baseline_year
    ),
    hearing_base = factor(
      hearing_base,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No hearing loss", "Hearing loss")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hearing_base), !is.na(t_event), t_event >= 0)

# 1) Cox model for HR
fit_cox_h <- coxph(Surv(t_event, event) ~ hearing_base, data = surv_base_h)
s_h <- summary(fit_cox_h)

HR_h  <- s_h$coef[1, "exp(coef)"]
LCL_h <- s_h$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
UCL_h <- s_h$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]

hr_text_h <- sprintf("HR (95%% CI): %.2f (%.2f\u2013%.2f)", HR_h, LCL_h, UCL_h)

# Log-rank p-value
sd_h <- survdiff(Surv(t_event, event) ~ hearing_base, data = surv_base_h)
p_lr_h <- 1 - pchisq(sd_h$chisq, df = length(sd_h$n) - 1)
p_text_h <- ifelse(p_lr_h < 0.001, "Log-rank p < 0.001",
                   sprintf("Log-rank p = %.3f", p_lr_h))

ann_text_h <- paste(hr_text_h, p_text_h, sep = "\n")

# 2) KM fit
fit_km_h <- survfit(Surv(t_event, event) ~ hearing_base, data = surv_base_h)

# 3) Plot
p_h <- ggsurvplot(
  fit_km_h,
  data = surv_base_h,
  fun = "event",
  conf.int = TRUE,
  conf.int.style = "ribbon",
  censor = FALSE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.col = "strata",
  break.time.by = 4,
  palette = c("#00BFC4", "#F8766D"),
  legend.title = "Baseline hearing",
  legend.labs = c("No hearing loss", "Hearing loss"),
  xlab = "Follow-up time (years)",
  ylab = "Cumulative incidence of dementia",
  title = "Cumulative Incidence of Dementia by Hearing Status (HRS)"
)

# 4) Add HR + p-value
p_h$plot <- p_h$plot +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = ann_text_h,
    hjust = 1.02, vjust = -0.25,
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 25, 10))

print(p_h)

     width = 8, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300, compression = "lzw")
print(p_h)
```

# Subgroup analysis
```{r}
library(survival); library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(tibble); library(tidyr)

add_subgroup_factors <- function(d) {
  d %>% mutate(
    age_cat = factor(if_else(as.numeric(baseline_age) < 65, "<65", "\u226565"),
                     levels = c("<65", "\u226565")),
    sex_cat = factor(case_when(
      as.character(Gender) %in% c("1","Male","male","M")     ~ "Male",
      as.character(Gender) %in% c("2","Female","female","F") ~ "Female"
    ), levels = c("Male","Female"))
  )
}
tv_cc         <- add_subgroup_factors(tv_cc)
df_tv_hearing <- add_subgroup_factors(df_tv_hearing)
df_tv_vision  <- add_subgroup_factors(df_tv_vision)

subgroup_specs <- tribble(~label,~var,
                          "Age at baseline","age_cat",
                          "Sex","sex_cat")
drop_in_strata <- c(age_cat = "baseline_age", sex_cat = "Gender")
base_covs <- c("baseline_age","Gender","Race","Education","Marital_status",
               "emp_lag","smoke_lag","alcohol_lag")

fit_cox <- function(data, rhs_terms, time_vars) {
  fml <- reformulate(rhs_terms,
                     response = sprintf("Surv(%s, %s, %s)",
                                        time_vars[1], time_vars[2], time_vars[3]))
  tryCatch(coxph(fml, data = data, cluster = hhidpn,
                 ties = "efron", na.action = na.omit),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}
p_interaction <- function(data, exposure, gv, extra_rhs, time_vars) {
  cv  <- setdiff(c(base_covs, extra_rhs), drop_in_strata[[gv]])
  rhs <- unique(c(paste0(exposure," * ",gv), cv))
  fit <- fit_cox(data, rhs, time_vars); if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  nm <- names(coef(fit))
  ix <- which(grepl(":", nm) &
                (grepl(paste0("^",exposure), nm) | grepl(paste0(":",exposure), nm)) &
                grepl(gv, nm))
  if (!length(ix)) return(NA_real_)
  b <- coef(fit)[ix]; V <- vcov(fit)[ix, ix, drop = FALSE]
  pchisq(as.numeric(t(b) %*% solve(V) %*% b), df = length(ix), lower.tail = FALSE)
}

run_m4_binary <- function(data, exposure, time_vars, extra_rhs) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(subgroup_specs)), function(k) {
    g <- subgroup_specs$label[k]; gv <- subgroup_specs$var[k]
    pi <- p_interaction(data, exposure, gv, extra_rhs, time_vars)
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(data[[gv]])), function(lv) {
      sub <- data %>% filter(.data[[gv]] == lv)
      cv  <- setdiff(c(base_covs, extra_rhs), drop_in_strata[[gv]])
      fit <- fit_cox(sub, unique(c(exposure, cv)), time_vars)
      if (is.null(fit) || !(exposure %in% names(coef(fit))))
        return(tibble(group=g, stratum=lv, n_int=nrow(sub),
                      n_ev=sum(sub[[time_vars[3]]]==1, na.rm=TRUE),
                      HR=NA_real_, lo=NA_real_, hi=NA_real_, p_int=pi))
      cf <- summary(fit)$conf.int; i <- which(rownames(cf) == exposure)
      tibble(group=g, stratum=lv, n_int=fit$n, n_ev=fit$nevent,
             HR=cf[i,1], lo=cf[i,3], hi=cf[i,4], p_int=pi)
    })
  }) %>% group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(p_int=if_else(row_number()==1, p_int, NA_real_)) %>% ungroup()
}
run_m4_frailty <- function(data, time_vars)
  run_m4_binary(data, "frailty_lag", time_vars,
                extra_rhs = c("hearing_lag","vision_lag"))

run_m5 <- function(data, time_vars=c("start","stop","dementia_event")) {
  exposure <- "ctx_lag"
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(subgroup_specs)), function(k) {
    g <- subgroup_specs$label[k]; gv <- subgroup_specs$var[k]
    pi <- p_interaction(data, exposure, gv, NULL, time_vars)
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(data[[gv]])), function(lv) {
      sub <- data %>% filter(.data[[gv]] == lv)
      sub[[exposure]] <- droplevels(sub[[exposure]])
      cv <- setdiff(base_covs, drop_in_strata[[gv]])
      fit <- fit_cox(sub, c(exposure, cv), time_vars)
      out <- tibble(group=g, stratum=lv,
                    n_int=if (is.null(fit)) nrow(sub) else fit$n,
                    n_ev =if (is.null(fit))
                      sum(sub[[time_vars[3]]]==1, na.rm=TRUE) else fit$nevent,
                    HR_1=NA_real_,lo_1=NA_real_,hi_1=NA_real_,
                    HR_2=NA_real_,lo_2=NA_real_,hi_2=NA_real_, p_int=pi)
      if (!is.null(fit)) {
        cf <- summary(fit)$conf.int; nm <- rownames(cf)
        ix <- which(grepl(paste0("^",exposure),nm) & !grepl(":",nm))
        if (length(ix)>=1) { out$HR_1<-cf[ix[1],1];out$lo_1<-cf[ix[1],3];out$hi_1<-cf[ix[1],4] }
        if (length(ix)>=2) { out$HR_2<-cf[ix[2],1];out$lo_2<-cf[ix[2],3];out$hi_2<-cf[ix[2],4] }
      }
      out
    })
  }) %>% group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(p_int=if_else(row_number()==1, p_int, NA_real_)) %>% ungroup()
}

res_m4_hearing <- run_m4_binary(tv_cc, "hearing_lag",
                                c("tstart","tstop","event"), extra_rhs="frailty_lag")
res_m4_vision  <- run_m4_binary(tv_cc, "vision_lag",
                                c("tstart","tstop","event"), extra_rhs="frailty_lag")
res_m4_frailty <- run_m4_frailty(tv_cc, c("tstart","tstop","event"))
res_m5_hearing <- run_m5(df_tv_hearing)
res_m5_vision  <- run_m5(df_tv_vision)

# Sanity check (HRS sample sizes should be ~73k intervals)
cat("HRS m4_hearing intervals (first stratum):", res_m4_hearing$n_int[1], "\n")
cat("HRS m4_hearing events    (first stratum):", res_m4_hearing$n_ev[1],  "\n")

# Save
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)

```



# Calculate PAF for subgroup analysis
```{r}
# Subgroup PAF — Models 1-5 (HRS, dementia outcome)
# For every subgroup level we:
#   (1) subset the analytic dataset to that stratum,
#   (2) refit the model on that stratum (dropping the stratifier from RHS),
#   (3) recompute person-time-weighted exposure prevalence in that stratum,
#   (4) compute PAF (+ 95% CI via parametric bootstrap on log-HR).
#
# Dependencies expected in the environment:
#   tv_cc, df_tv_hearing, df_tv_vision (already augmented with
#   age_cat / sex_cat by add_subgroup_factors above).
# ============================================================================

library(survival); library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(tibble); library(tidyr)
set.seed(20260509)

# ---- Reuse PAF helpers (identical to overall PAF block) --------------------
paf_binary_fn <- function(p, HR) (p * (HR - 1)) / (p * (HR - 1) + 1)

paf_ci_binary <- function(fit, term, p, nsim = 10000) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[term])
  V <- vcov(fit)[term, term]
  if (is.na(b) || !is.finite(V) || V <= 0)
    return(tibble(HR = NA_real_, PAF = NA_real_, lcl = NA_real_, ucl = NA_real_))
  sims <- rnorm(nsim, mean = b, sd = sqrt(V))
  pafs <- paf_binary_fn(p, exp(sims))
  tibble(
    HR  = exp(b),
    PAF = paf_binary_fn(p, exp(b)),
    lcl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    ucl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

paf_ci_multicat <- function(fit, terms, p_vec, labels, nsim = 10000) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[terms])
  V <- vcov(fit)[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  if (any(is.na(b)) || any(!is.finite(diag(V))))
    return(tibble(component = c("Total", labels),
                  HR  = c(NA_real_, rep(NA_real_, length(labels))),
                  PAF = NA_real_, lcl = NA_real_, ucl = NA_real_))
  sims <- MASS::mvrnorm(nsim, mu = b, Sigma = V)
  if (is.vector(sims)) sims <- matrix(sims, ncol = length(terms))
  HRs <- exp(sims)
  comp_mat <- sweep(HRs - 1, 2, p_vec, `*`)
  s_all    <- rowSums(comp_mat)
  paf_total_sim <- s_all / (1 + s_all)
  paf_comp_sim  <- comp_mat / (1 + s_all)

  HR_est    <- exp(b)
  comp_est  <- p_vec * (HR_est - 1)
  s_all_est <- sum(comp_est)

  tibble(
    component = c("Total", labels),
    HR        = c(NA_real_, HR_est),
    PAF       = c(s_all_est / (1 + s_all_est),
                  comp_est  / (1 + s_all_est)),
    lcl       = c(unname(quantile(paf_total_sim, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  apply(paf_comp_sim, 2,
                        function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)))),
    ucl       = c(unname(quantile(paf_total_sim, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  apply(paf_comp_sim, 2,
                        function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))))
  )
}

prev_pt_binary <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x  <- dat[[var]]
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(pt)
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(pt[ok][x[ok] == 1], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(pt[ok], na.rm = TRUE)
}

prev_pt_factor <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt    <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x     <- dat[[var]]
  total <- sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    level = levels(x),
    p     = vapply(levels(x),
                   function(lv) sum(pt[x == lv], na.rm = TRUE) / total,
                   numeric(1))
  )
}

# ---- Subgroup spec (must match the subgroup analysis block) ----------------
subgroup_specs <- tribble(
  ~label,            ~var,
  "Age at baseline", "age_cat",
  "Sex",             "sex_cat"
)
# When stratifying by age_cat we drop baseline_age from the RHS;
# when stratifying by sex_cat we drop Gender.
drop_in_strata <- c(age_cat = "baseline_age", sex_cat = "Gender")

base_covs_14 <- c("baseline_age", "Gender", "Race", "Education", "Marital_status",
                  "emp_lag", "smoke_lag", "alcohol_lag")
base_covs_5  <- base_covs_14   # same set for Model 5

# ============================================================================
# Per-stratum refit helpers
# ============================================================================
fit_cox_strat <- function(data, rhs_terms, time_vars) {
  fml <- reformulate(rhs_terms,
                     response = sprintf("Surv(%s, %s, %s)",
                                        time_vars[1], time_vars[2], time_vars[3]))
  tryCatch(coxph(fml, data = data, cluster = hhidpn,
                 ties = "efron", na.action = na.omit),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}

# ----- Models 1-4: binary exposure -----
# model_id ∈ {"M1","M2","M3","M4"}; for M4, hearing/vision get frailty_lag
# added as a covariate, frailty uses the mutually-adjusted Cox.
build_rhs_14 <- function(model_id, exposure, gv) {
  drop <- drop_in_strata[[gv]]
  if (model_id == "M1") return(exposure)
  if (model_id == "M2") return(unique(c(exposure, setdiff("baseline_age", drop))))
  if (model_id == "M3") return(unique(c(exposure, setdiff(base_covs_14, drop))))
  if (model_id == "M4") {
    if (exposure == "frailty_lag") {
      return(unique(c("hearing_lag", "vision_lag", "frailty_lag",
                      setdiff(base_covs_14, drop))))
    } else {
      return(unique(c(exposure, "frailty_lag",
                      setdiff(base_covs_14, drop))))
    }
  }
  stop("Unknown model_id: ", model_id)
}

paf_subgroup_14 <- function(data, exposure, time_vars, model_id, exposure_label) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(subgroup_specs)), function(k) {
    g  <- subgroup_specs$label[k]
    gv <- subgroup_specs$var[k]
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(data[[gv]])), function(lv) {
      sub <- data %>% filter(.data[[gv]] == lv)
      p   <- prev_pt_binary(sub, exposure, time_vars[1], time_vars[2])
      rhs <- build_rhs_14(model_id, exposure, gv)
      fit <- fit_cox_strat(sub, rhs, time_vars)
      if (is.null(fit) || !(exposure %in% names(coef(fit))) ||
          is.na(p) || p <= 0) {
        return(tibble(model = model_id, exposure = exposure_label,
                      group = g, stratum = lv,
                      n_int = nrow(sub),
                      n_ev  = sum(sub[[time_vars[3]]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                      p_pt = p, HR = NA_real_, PAF = NA_real_,
                      PAF_lcl = NA_real_, PAF_ucl = NA_real_))
      }
      res <- paf_ci_binary(fit, exposure, p)
      tibble(model = model_id, exposure = exposure_label,
             group = g, stratum = lv,
             n_int = fit$n, n_ev = fit$nevent,
             p_pt = p, HR = res$HR,
             PAF = res$PAF, PAF_lcl = res$lcl, PAF_ucl = res$ucl)
    })
  })
}

# ----- Model 5: 3-level ctx_lag -----
paf_subgroup_5 <- function(data, model_label,
                           time_vars = c("start", "stop", "dementia_event")) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(subgroup_specs)), function(k) {
    g  <- subgroup_specs$label[k]
    gv <- subgroup_specs$var[k]
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(data[[gv]])), function(lv) {
      sub <- data %>% filter(.data[[gv]] == lv)
      sub$ctx_lag <- droplevels(sub$ctx_lag)
      cv  <- setdiff(base_covs_5, drop_in_strata[[gv]])
      fit <- fit_cox_strat(sub, c("ctx_lag", cv), time_vars)

      if (is.null(fit)) {
        return(tibble(model = model_label, exposure = "Total",
                      group = g, stratum = lv,
                      n_int = nrow(sub),
                      n_ev  = sum(sub[[time_vars[3]]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                      p_pt = NA_real_, HR = NA_real_, PAF = NA_real_,
                      PAF_lcl = NA_real_, PAF_ucl = NA_real_))
      }

      ctx_levels   <- levels(sub$ctx_lag)
      exposed_lvls <- ctx_levels[-1]
      terms        <- paste0("ctx_lag", exposed_lvls)
      terms        <- intersect(terms, names(coef(fit)))
      exposed_lvls <- sub("^ctx_lag", "", terms)

      prev_tab  <- prev_pt_factor(sub, "ctx_lag", time_vars[1], time_vars[2])
      p_exposed <- setNames(prev_tab$p[match(exposed_lvls, prev_tab$level)],
                            exposed_lvls)

      if (!length(terms) || any(is.na(p_exposed)) || any(p_exposed <= 0)) {
        return(tibble(model = model_label, exposure = "Total",
                      group = g, stratum = lv,
                      n_int = fit$n, n_ev = fit$nevent,
                      p_pt = NA_real_, HR = NA_real_, PAF = NA_real_,
                      PAF_lcl = NA_real_, PAF_ucl = NA_real_))
      }

      tab <- paf_ci_multicat(fit, terms, p_exposed, exposed_lvls)
      tab %>%
        mutate(model = model_label,
               exposure = component,
               group = g, stratum = lv,
               n_int = fit$n, n_ev = fit$nevent,
               p_pt = c(NA_real_, unname(p_exposed))) %>%
        dplyr::select(model, exposure, group, stratum, n_int, n_ev,
                      p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl = lcl, PAF_ucl = ucl)
    })
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# Run Models 1-4 by subgroup
# ============================================================================
tv_time <- c("tstart", "tstop", "event")

paf_sg_14 <- bind_rows(
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", tv_time, "M1", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "vision_lag",  tv_time, "M1", "Vision loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "frailty_lag", tv_time, "M1", "Frailty"),

  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", tv_time, "M2", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "vision_lag",  tv_time, "M2", "Vision loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "frailty_lag", tv_time, "M2", "Frailty"),

  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", tv_time, "M3", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "vision_lag",  tv_time, "M3", "Vision loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "frailty_lag", tv_time, "M3", "Frailty"),

  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", tv_time, "M4", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "vision_lag",  tv_time, "M4", "Vision loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "frailty_lag", tv_time, "M4", "Frailty")
)

# ============================================================================
# Run Model 5 by subgroup (hearing context + vision context)
# ============================================================================
paf_sg_5 <- bind_rows(
  paf_subgroup_5(df_tv_hearing, "M5 (hearing context)"),
  paf_subgroup_5(df_tv_vision,  "M5 (vision context)")
)

# ============================================================================
# Combined subgroup PAF table
# ============================================================================
paf_subgroup_all <- bind_rows(paf_sg_14, paf_sg_5) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_fmt  = ifelse(is.na(HR), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", HR)),
    PAF_fmt = ifelse(is.na(PAF), NA_character_,
                     sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",
                             100 * PAF, 100 * PAF_lcl, 100 * PAF_ucl))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, group, stratum,
                n_int, n_ev, p_pt, HR, HR_fmt,
                PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl, PAF_fmt)

cat("\n=== Subgroup PAF: Models 1-5 (HRS) ===\n")
print(paf_subgroup_all, n = Inf)


# Combine Cox subgroup HRs + PAFs into one tidy table for forest plots
# ============================================================================
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(purrr)

# ---- 1) Reshape Cox subgroup HRs into a common long format -----------------
#     columns: model, exposure, group, stratum, n_int, n_ev,
#              HR, HR_lcl, HR_ucl, p_int
tidy_m4 <- function(d, exposure_label) {
  d %>%
    transmute(model = "M4", exposure = exposure_label,
              group, stratum, n_int, n_ev,
              HR, HR_lcl = lo, HR_ucl = hi, p_int)
}

tidy_m5 <- function(d, ctx) {
  # ctx is "hearing" or "vision"; M5 has two non-reference levels per stratum
  lab1 <- paste0(ctx, ", no frailty yet")
  lab2 <- paste0(ctx, ", frailty present")
  d %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(HR_1, lo_1, hi_1, HR_2, lo_2, hi_2),
      names_to  = c(".value", "lvl"),
      names_pattern = "(HR|lo|hi)_(\\d)"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      model    = paste0("M5 (", ctx, " context)"),
      exposure = if_else(lvl == "1", lab1, lab2)
    ) %>%
    transmute(model, exposure, group, stratum, n_int, n_ev,
              HR, HR_lcl = lo, HR_ucl = hi, p_int)
}

hr_long <- bind_rows(
  tidy_m4(res_m4_hearing, "Hearing loss"),
  tidy_m4(res_m4_vision,  "Vision loss"),
  tidy_m4(res_m4_frailty, "Frailty"),
  tidy_m5(res_m5_hearing, "hearing"),
  tidy_m5(res_m5_vision,  "vision")
)

# ---- 2) Normalise exposure labels in the PAF table to match hr_long --------
#     PAF M5 uses the factor levels you set in build_m5_dataset(), e.g.
#     "Hearing loss, no frailty yet" / "Hearing loss, frailty present".
#     Rewrite them to the short form ("hearing, ..." / "vision, ...") so they
#     join cleanly with the M5 HR rows.
paf_join <- paf_subgroup_all %>%
  mutate(
    exposure = case_when(
      grepl("^Hearing loss, ", exposure) ~ sub("^Hearing loss", "hearing", exposure),
      grepl("^Vision loss, ",  exposure) ~ sub("^Vision loss",  "vision",  exposure),
      TRUE ~ exposure
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, group, stratum,
                p_pt, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl)

# ---- 3) Master long table (HR + PAF) ---------------------------------------
forest_long <- hr_long %>%
  left_join(paf_join, by = c("model", "exposure", "group", "stratum")) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_fmt  = ifelse(is.na(HR),  NA_character_,
                     sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", HR,  HR_lcl,  HR_ucl)),
    PAF_fmt = ifelse(is.na(PAF), NA_character_,
                     sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",
                             100*PAF, 100*PAF_lcl, 100*PAF_ucl)),
    p_int_fmt = ifelse(is.na(p_int), NA_character_,
                       ifelse(p_int < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_int)))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, group, stratum,
                n_int, n_ev, p_pt,
                HR, HR_lcl, HR_ucl, HR_fmt,
                PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl, PAF_fmt,
                p_int, p_int_fmt)

cat("\n=== Combined subgroup HR + PAF (forest-plot ready) ===\n")
print(forest_long, n = Inf)

# ---- 4) Save everything in one place ---------------------------------------
dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)

subgroup_HRS <- list(
  # raw Cox subgroup outputs (kept for reproducibility)
  cox = list(
    m4_h = res_m4_hearing,
    m4_v = res_m4_vision,
    m4_f = res_m4_frailty,
    m5_h = res_m5_hearing,
    m5_v = res_m5_vision
  ),
  # raw subgroup PAF outputs
  paf = paf_subgroup_all,
  # joined long-format table for forest plots
  forest = forest_long
)

saveRDS(subgroup_HRS, "results/subgroup_HRS.rds")
write.csv(forest_long,       "results/subgroup_HRS_forest.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(paf_subgroup_all,  "results/subgroup_HRS_paf.csv",    row.names = FALSE)
```
