# Sensitivity analysis 3: Fine-Gray sub-distribution hazard
# Competing event = death from any cause before dementia
```{r}
# Step 1. Build a 3-level competing-risk status on the interval data
#   0 = censored, 1 = dementia, 2 = death (before dementia)
#   Death is assigned only to the LAST observed interval for individuals
#   who died without an incident dementia diagnosis.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
tv_fg <- tv_cc %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, tstart) %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  mutate(
    is_last_int   = row_number() == n(),
    ever_dem      = cumsum(event),
    death_at_last = as.integer(is_last_int & died == 1 & ever_dem == 0),
    status_cr = case_when(
      event == 1         ~ 1L,
      death_at_last == 1 ~ 2L,
      TRUE               ~ 0L
    ),
    status_fac = factor(status_cr,
                        levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                        labels = c("censor", "dementia", "death"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-is_last_int, -ever_dem, -death_at_last)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1b. Stitch intervals so each subject has contiguous time.
#   Complete-case filtering in tv_cc can drop interior intervals; this
#   re-anchors each row's tstart to the previous tstop within subject.
#   Entry time is 0 (baseline_year anchor).
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
tv_fg <- tv_fg %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, tstop) %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  mutate(tstart = lag(tstop, default = 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Sanity: no gaps remain
gap_total <- tv_fg %>%
  arrange(hhidpn, tstop) %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  summarise(
    n_gaps = sum(tstart != lag(tstop, default = first(tstart))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  summarise(total_gaps = sum(n_gaps)) %>%
  pull(total_gaps)
cat("Interval gaps after stitching:", gap_total, "\n")

cat("\nCompeting-risk status across intervals:\n")
print(table(tv_fg$status_fac))

cat("\nPerson-level terminal status:\n")
tv_fg %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  summarise(final_status = max(status_cr), .groups = "drop") %>%
  count(final_status) %>%
  print()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 2. Build the Fine-Gray weighted dataset for the dementia outcome.
#   finegray() keeps competing-event subjects in the risk set with
#   time-decreasing IPCW weights (fgwt) and produces (fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus).
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
fg_dat <- finegray(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, status_fac) ~ .,
  data  = tv_fg,
  id    = hhidpn,
  etype = "dementia"
)

cat("\nFG expanded rows:", nrow(fg_dat),
    " | unique persons:", dplyr::n_distinct(fg_dat$hhidpn),
    " | sub-distribution events:", sum(fg_dat$fgstatus), "\n")

cat("Dementia events in tv_fg :", sum(tv_fg$status_cr == 1), "\n")
cat("Sub-dist events in fg_dat:", sum(fg_dat$fgstatus), "\n")

# ======================================================================
# Fine-Gray models -- same M1-M4 structure as the primary analysis
# Use fgwt as case weights and cluster() for robust SEs.
# ======================================================================

# ---------------- M1: Unadjusted ----------------
fg_m1_hearing <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ hearing_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m1_hearing); fit_n(fg_m1_hearing, "FG-M1 hearing")

fg_m1_vision <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ vision_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m1_vision); fit_n(fg_m1_vision, "FG-M1 vision")

fg_m1_frailty <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ frailty_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m1_frailty); fit_n(fg_m1_frailty, "FG-M1 frailty")

# ---------------- M2: + baseline age ----------------
fg_m2_hearing <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ hearing_lag + baseline_age +
    cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m2_hearing); fit_n(fg_m2_hearing, "FG-M2 hearing")

fg_m2_vision <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ vision_lag + baseline_age +
    cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m2_vision); fit_n(fg_m2_vision, "FG-M2 vision")

fg_m2_frailty <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ frailty_lag + baseline_age +
    cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m2_frailty); fit_n(fg_m2_frailty, "FG-M2 frailty")

# ---------------- M3: + demographics + lifestyle ----------------
fg_m3_hearing <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ hearing_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag +
    cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m3_hearing); fit_n(fg_m3_hearing, "FG-M3 hearing")

fg_m3_vision <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ vision_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag +
    cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m3_vision); fit_n(fg_m3_vision, "FG-M3 vision")

fg_m3_frailty <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ frailty_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag +
    cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m3_frailty); fit_n(fg_m3_frailty, "FG-M3 frailty")

# ---------------- M4 (PRIMARY hybrid): ----------------
# Hearing row: + frailty as covariate
# Vision  row: + frailty as covariate
# Frailty row: mutually adjusted (hearing + vision + frailty)

fg_m4_hearing <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ hearing_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + frailty_lag +
    cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m4_hearing); fit_n(fg_m4_hearing, "FG-M4 hearing")

fg_m4_vision <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ vision_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + frailty_lag +
    cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m4_vision); fit_n(fg_m4_vision, "FG-M4 vision")

fg_m4_frailty <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~
    hearing_lag + vision_lag + frailty_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag +
    cluster(hhidpn),
  data = fg_dat, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"
)
summary(fg_m4_frailty); fit_n(fg_m4_frailty, "FG-M4 frailty")

# ======================================================================
# Collate Fine-Gray sub-distribution HRs (M1-M4) for the manuscript table
# ======================================================================
fg_hr_table <- bind_rows(
  tidy_hr(fg_m1_hearing, "hearing_lag",  "FG-M1: Unadjusted"),
  tidy_hr(fg_m1_vision,  "vision_lag",   "FG-M1: Unadjusted"),
  tidy_hr(fg_m1_frailty, "frailty_lag",  "FG-M1: Unadjusted"),

  tidy_hr(fg_m2_hearing, "hearing_lag",  "FG-M2: + age"),
  tidy_hr(fg_m2_vision,  "vision_lag",   "FG-M2: + age"),
  tidy_hr(fg_m2_frailty, "frailty_lag",  "FG-M2: + age"),

  tidy_hr(fg_m3_hearing, "hearing_lag",  "FG-M3: + demographics + lifestyle"),
  tidy_hr(fg_m3_vision,  "vision_lag",   "FG-M3: + demographics + lifestyle"),
  tidy_hr(fg_m3_frailty, "frailty_lag",  "FG-M3: + demographics + lifestyle"),

  tidy_hr(fg_m4_hearing, "hearing_lag",  "FG-M4: hybrid (primary)"),
  tidy_hr(fg_m4_vision,  "vision_lag",   "FG-M4: hybrid (primary)"),
  tidy_hr(fg_m4_frailty, c("hearing_lag","vision_lag","frailty_lag"),
                                         "FG-M4: hybrid (primary)")
) %>%
  rename(sHR = HR) %>%
  mutate(sHR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", sHR, conf.low, conf.high)) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, term, sHR, conf.low, conf.high, sHR_CI, p.value)

print(fg_hr_table)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================================
# Sensitivity analysis: Fine-Gray competing-risk for Model 5
# Competing event = death from any cause before dementia
# Self-contained: rebuilds the M5 interval datasets, then runs FG.
# ==========================================================================
library(survival)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Ensure panel_df_eligible has death tracking attached
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (!"died" %in% names(panel_df_eligible)) {
  panel_df_eligible <- panel_df_eligible %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("death_year", "death_month", "death_date", "died"))) %>%
    mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)) %>%
    left_join(
      death_track_clean %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn)),
      by = "hhidpn"
    )
}
stopifnot("hhidpn" %in% names(panel_df_eligible),
          "died"   %in% names(panel_df_eligible))

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) build_m5_dataset() — death tracking baked in by construction
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_m5_dataset <- function(panel_df, baseline_df,
                             sensory_var, sensory_label,
                             death_track = death_track_clean) {

  df_tv <- panel_df %>%
    mutate(
      hhidpn        = as.character(hhidpn),
      year          = as.integer(year),
      baseline_year = as.integer(baseline_year),
      int_date      = make_midyear_date(year),
      baseline_date = make_midyear_date(baseline_year),
      time          = as.numeric(difftime(int_date, baseline_date,
                                          units = "days")) / 365.25,
      .sensory      = .data[[sensory_var]]
    ) %>%
    arrange(hhidpn, time) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(
      sensory_onset_time = if (any(.sensory == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[.sensory == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
                           else NA_real_,
      frailty_onset_time = if (any(Frailty_status == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[Frailty_status == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
                           else NA_real_,
      dem_time           = if (any(dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[dementia == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
                           else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(sensory_tv = dplyr::if_else(.sensory == 1, 1L, 0L))

  df_tv <- df_tv %>%
    arrange(hhidpn, time) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(
      start = lag(time),
      stop  = time,
      dementia_event  = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(dem_time) & stop == dem_time, 1L, 0L),
      frailty_by_stop = !is.na(frailty_onset_time) & frailty_onset_time <= stop,
      ctx_tv = case_when(
        sensory_tv == 0                     ~ 0L,
        sensory_tv == 1 & !frailty_by_stop  ~ 1L,
        sensory_tv == 1 &  frailty_by_stop  ~ 2L,
        TRUE                                ~ NA_integer_
      ),
      ctx_lag     = lag(ctx_tv),
      emp_lag     = lag(Employment),
      smoke_lag   = lag(Smoking),
      alcohol_lag = lag(Alcohol)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  df_tv <- df_tv %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(start),
      stop > start,
      is.na(dem_time) | start < dem_time,
      !is.na(ctx_lag)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ctx_lag = factor(
        ctx_lag,
        levels = c(0, 1, 2),
        labels = c(paste0("No ", sensory_label, " (ref)"),
                   paste0(sensory_label, ", no frailty yet"),
                   paste0(sensory_label, ", frailty present"))
      ),
      emp_lag     = droplevels(factor(emp_lag)),
      smoke_lag   = droplevels(factor(smoke_lag)),
      alcohol_lag = droplevels(factor(alcohol_lag))
    )

  baseline_invariant <- baseline_df %>%
    dplyr::select(hhidpn, Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, age) %>%
    rename(baseline_age = age) %>%
    mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn))

  df_tv <- df_tv %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("Gender", "Race", "Education", "Marital_status"))) %>%
    left_join(baseline_invariant, by = "hhidpn") %>%
    mutate(
      baseline_age   = as.numeric(baseline_age),
      Gender         = droplevels(factor(Gender)),
      Race           = droplevels(factor(Race)),
      Education      = droplevels(factor(Education)),
      Marital_status = droplevels(factor(Marital_status))
    )

  death_track <- death_track %>% mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn))
  df_tv <- df_tv %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("death_year", "death_month", "death_date", "died"))) %>%
    left_join(death_track, by = "hhidpn")

  stopifnot(
    "hhidpn" %in% names(df_tv),
    "died"   %in% names(df_tv),
    !any(df_tv$start >= df_tv$stop),
    !any(is.na(df_tv$ctx_lag))
  )
  df_tv
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Rebuild M5 datasets from scratch
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
df_tv_hearing <- build_m5_dataset(
  panel_df      = panel_df_eligible,
  baseline_df   = baseline_df_eligible,
  sensory_var   = "hearing_loss",
  sensory_label = "Hearing loss",
  death_track   = death_track_clean
)

df_tv_vision <- build_m5_dataset(
  panel_df      = panel_df_eligible,
  baseline_df   = baseline_df_eligible,
  sensory_var   = "vision_overall",
  sensory_label = "Vision loss",
  death_track   = death_track_clean
)

cat("\nRebuild verification:\n")
cat("  df_tv_hearing - hhidpn:", "hhidpn" %in% names(df_tv_hearing),
    "| died:", "died" %in% names(df_tv_hearing), "\n")
cat("  df_tv_vision  - hhidpn:", "hhidpn" %in% names(df_tv_vision),
    "| died:", "died" %in% names(df_tv_vision),  "\n")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Fine-Gray helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_m5_fg_dataset <- function(m5_dat, label) {
  cat("\n--- Building FG dataset:", label, "---\n")
  stopifnot("hhidpn" %in% names(m5_dat), "died" %in% names(m5_dat))

  # 3-level competing-risk status
  tv_fg <- m5_dat %>%
    arrange(hhidpn, start) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(
      is_last_int   = row_number() == n(),
      ever_dem      = cumsum(dementia_event),
      death_at_last = as.integer(is_last_int & died == 1 & ever_dem == 0),
      status_cr = case_when(
        dementia_event == 1 ~ 1L,
        death_at_last == 1  ~ 2L,
        TRUE                ~ 0L
      ),
      status_fac = factor(status_cr,
                          levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                          labels = c("censor", "dementia", "death"))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-is_last_int, -ever_dem, -death_at_last)

  # Stitch gaps so finegray() accepts (start, stop] intervals
  tv_fg <- tv_fg %>%
    arrange(hhidpn, stop) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(start = lag(stop, default = 0)) %>%
    ungroup()

  gap_total <- tv_fg %>%
    arrange(hhidpn, stop) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    summarise(
      n_gaps = sum(start != lag(stop, default = first(start))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    summarise(total_gaps = sum(n_gaps)) %>%
    pull(total_gaps)
  cat("Interval gaps after stitching:", gap_total, "\n")

  cat("Competing-risk status across intervals:\n")
  print(table(tv_fg$status_fac))

  cat("Person-level terminal status:\n")
  tv_fg %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    summarise(final_status = max(status_cr), .groups = "drop") %>%
    count(final_status) %>%
    print()

  # Fine-Gray expansion
  fg_dat <- finegray(
    Surv(start, stop, status_fac) ~ .,
    data  = tv_fg,
    id    = hhidpn,
    etype = "dementia"
  )

  cat("FG rows:", nrow(fg_dat),
      " | unique persons:", dplyr::n_distinct(fg_dat$hhidpn),
      " | sub-distribution events:", sum(fg_dat$fgstatus), "\n")
  cat("Dementia events in tv_fg :", sum(tv_fg$status_cr == 1), "\n")

  fg_dat
}

fit_m5_fg <- function(fg_dat, label) {
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat(label, "Model 5 - Fine-Gray (3-level; ref = No sensory impairment)\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat("FG rows:", nrow(fg_dat),
      " | sub-distribution events:", sum(fg_dat$fgstatus),
      " | persons:", dplyr::n_distinct(fg_dat$hhidpn), "\n\n")

  cat("Category distribution (FG-expanded, interval-level):\n")
  print(table(fg_dat$ctx_lag, useNA = "ifany"))

  fit <- coxph(
    Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~
      ctx_lag + baseline_age +
      Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
      emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag +
      cluster(hhidpn),
    data    = fg_dat,
    weights = fgwt,
    ties    = "efron"
  )

  cat("\n--- Fine-Gray fit ---\n")
  print(summary(fit))
  fit
}

contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_fg <- function(fit, label) {
  co <- coef(fit)
  vc <- vcov(fit)
  i_no_fr  <- grep("no frailty yet",  names(co))
  i_fr_yes <- grep("frailty present", names(co))

  L <- numeric(length(co))
  L[i_fr_yes] <-  1
  L[i_no_fr]  <- -1

  est <- sum(L * co)
  se  <- sqrt(t(L) %*% vc %*% L)[1, 1]
  z   <- est / se
  p   <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n[%s | FG] log-sHR(frailty present) - log-sHR(no frailty yet) = %.3f (SE %.3f), z = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
    label, est, se, z, p
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "  Ratio of sHRs (frailty present / no frailty yet) = %.2f (95%% CI %.2f-%.2f)\n",
    exp(est), exp(est - 1.96 * se), exp(est + 1.96 * se)
  ))
  invisible(list(estimate = est, se = se, p = p,
                 ratio = exp(est),
                 ci = exp(est + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * se)))
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Run the Fine-Gray sensitivity analysis
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
fg_dat_hearing_m5 <- build_m5_fg_dataset(df_tv_hearing, "HEARING")
fg_dat_vision_m5  <- build_m5_fg_dataset(df_tv_vision,  "VISION")

fit_m5_fg_hearing <- fit_m5_fg(fg_dat_hearing_m5, "HEARING")
fit_m5_fg_vision  <- fit_m5_fg(fg_dat_vision_m5,  "VISION")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Within-exposed contrast (sHR ratio: frailty present vs no frailty yet)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_fg(fit_m5_fg_hearing, "HEARING")
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_fg(fit_m5_fg_vision,  "VISION")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Collate the M5 Fine-Gray sHRs for the supplementary table
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
m5_fg_table <- bind_rows(
  tidy_hr(
    fit_m5_fg_hearing,
    terms       = grep("^ctx_lag", names(coef(fit_m5_fg_hearing)), value = TRUE),
    model_label = "FG-M5 Hearing"
  ),
  tidy_hr(
    fit_m5_fg_vision,
    terms       = grep("^ctx_lag", names(coef(fit_m5_fg_vision)), value = TRUE),
    model_label = "FG-M5 Vision"
  )
) %>%
  rename(sHR = HR) %>%
  mutate(sHR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", sHR, conf.low, conf.high)) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, term, sHR, conf.low, conf.high, sHR_CI, p.value)

print(m5_fg_table)
```

# Population Attributable Fraction (PAF) for Fine-Gray models (M1-M5)
```{r}
# PAF derived from sub-distribution HRs via Levin's formula.
# Prevalence weighted by fgwt (sub-distribution risk-set).
# 95% CIs by subject-level cluster bootstrap.
# ======================================================================
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# ---- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------

# fgwt-weighted prevalence of exposure level(s) in the FG-expanded data
fg_prev <- function(fg_data, var_name) {
  x  <- fg_data[[var_name]]
  w  <- fg_data$fgwt
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w)
  x  <- x[ok]; w <- w[ok]
  if (is.factor(x)) {
    lv <- levels(x)[-1]                                # non-reference
    setNames(vapply(lv, function(l)
      sum(w * (x == l)) / sum(w), numeric(1)), lv)
  } else {
    sum(w * (x == 1)) / sum(w)                         # binary 0/1
  }
}

# Levin's PAF — accepts scalars or matched vectors
paf_levin <- function(sHR, p_e) {
  num <- sum(p_e * (sHR - 1))
  num / (1 + num)
}

# Point PAF from a fitted FG model + its dataset
paf_point <- function(fit, fg_data, exposure_var) {
  co  <- coef(fit)
  idx <- grep(paste0("^", exposure_var), names(co))
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  sHR <- exp(co[idx])
  p_e <- fg_prev(fg_data, exposure_var)
  if (is.factor(fg_data[[exposure_var]])) {
    coef_lv <- sub(paste0("^", exposure_var), "", names(co)[idx])
    p_e     <- p_e[coef_lv]                            # align order
  }
  paf_levin(sHR, p_e)
}

# Cluster bootstrap CI — resample subjects, refit FG, recompute PAF
paf_bootstrap_ci <- function(fg_data, formula, exposure_var,
                             R = 500, seed = 1, verbose = TRUE) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ids     <- unique(as.character(fg_data$hhidpn))
  n       <- length(ids)
  row_idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(fg_data)), as.character(fg_data$hhidpn))

  ests <- numeric(R)
  for (b in seq_len(R)) {
    samp <- sample(ids, n, replace = TRUE)
    rows <- unlist(row_idx[samp], use.names = FALSE)
    db   <- fg_data[rows, , drop = FALSE]
    fit_b <- tryCatch(
      coxph(formula, data = db, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"),
      error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) NULL
    )
    ests[b] <- if (is.null(fit_b)) NA_real_ else paf_point(fit_b, db, exposure_var)
    if (verbose && b %% 50 == 0) cat("  boot rep", b, "/", R, "\n")
  }
  ests <- ests[is.finite(ests)]
  list(n_valid = length(ests),
       ci      = unname(quantile(ests, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)))
}

# One-row tibble per (model, exposure)
paf_row <- function(fit, fg_data, formula, exposure_var, label,
                    R = 500, seed = 1) {
  pt <- paf_point(fit, fg_data, exposure_var)
  bs <- paf_bootstrap_ci(fg_data, formula, exposure_var, R = R, seed = seed)
  tibble(
    model     = label,
    exposure  = exposure_var,
    PAF       = pt,
    lower     = bs$ci[1],
    upper     = bs$ci[2],
    n_boot_ok = bs$n_valid,
    PAF_CI    = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% to %.1f%%)",
                        100 * pt, 100 * bs$ci[1], 100 * bs$ci[2])
  )
}

# ---- M1-M4 (use fg_dat) ----------------------------------------------
R_boot <- 500                                          # use 50-100 for testing

# M1: unadjusted
paf_m1_hearing <- paf_row(fg_m1_hearing, fg_dat,
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ hearing_lag,
  "hearing_lag", "FG-M1 hearing", R = R_boot, seed = 11)
paf_m1_vision  <- paf_row(fg_m1_vision, fg_dat,
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ vision_lag,
  "vision_lag",  "FG-M1 vision",  R = R_boot, seed = 12)
paf_m1_frailty <- paf_row(fg_m1_frailty, fg_dat,
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ frailty_lag,
  "frailty_lag", "FG-M1 frailty", R = R_boot, seed = 13)

# M2: + baseline age
paf_m2_hearing <- paf_row(fg_m2_hearing, fg_dat,
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ hearing_lag + baseline_age,
  "hearing_lag", "FG-M2 hearing", R = R_boot, seed = 21)
paf_m2_vision  <- paf_row(fg_m2_vision, fg_dat,
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ vision_lag  + baseline_age,
  "vision_lag",  "FG-M2 vision",  R = R_boot, seed = 22)
paf_m2_frailty <- paf_row(fg_m2_frailty, fg_dat,
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ frailty_lag + baseline_age,
  "frailty_lag", "FG-M2 frailty", R = R_boot, seed = 23)

# M3: + demographics + lifestyle
m3_cov <- ~ baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
              emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag
paf_m3_hearing <- paf_row(fg_m3_hearing, fg_dat,
  update(m3_cov, Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ hearing_lag + .),
  "hearing_lag", "FG-M3 hearing", R = R_boot, seed = 31)
paf_m3_vision  <- paf_row(fg_m3_vision,  fg_dat,
  update(m3_cov, Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ vision_lag  + .),
  "vision_lag",  "FG-M3 vision",  R = R_boot, seed = 32)
paf_m3_frailty <- paf_row(fg_m3_frailty, fg_dat,
  update(m3_cov, Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ frailty_lag + .),
  "frailty_lag", "FG-M3 frailty", R = R_boot, seed = 33)

# M4 hybrid: hearing & vision rows include frailty_lag as a covariate
m4_cov_hv <- ~ baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
                  emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + frailty_lag
paf_m4_hearing <- paf_row(fg_m4_hearing, fg_dat,
  update(m4_cov_hv, Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ hearing_lag + .),
  "hearing_lag", "FG-M4 hearing", R = R_boot, seed = 41)
paf_m4_vision  <- paf_row(fg_m4_vision,  fg_dat,
  update(m4_cov_hv, Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ vision_lag  + .),
  "vision_lag",  "FG-M4 vision",  R = R_boot, seed = 42)

# M4 frailty row: mutually adjusted (hearing + vision + frailty in one fit)
m4_fr_formula <- Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~
    hearing_lag + vision_lag + frailty_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag
paf_m4_fr_hearing <- paf_row(fg_m4_frailty, fg_dat, m4_fr_formula,
  "hearing_lag", "FG-M4 (mutual) hearing", R = R_boot, seed = 431)
paf_m4_fr_vision  <- paf_row(fg_m4_frailty, fg_dat, m4_fr_formula,
  "vision_lag",  "FG-M4 (mutual) vision",  R = R_boot, seed = 432)
paf_m4_fr_frailty <- paf_row(fg_m4_frailty, fg_dat, m4_fr_formula,
  "frailty_lag", "FG-M4 (mutual) frailty", R = R_boot, seed = 433)

# Level-specific PAFs for a multi-level factor exposure (M5 ctx_lag)
# Partial-PAF decomposition: sum of level PAFs = joint 
paf_point_by_level <- function(fit, fg_data, exposure_var) {
  co  <- coef(fit)
  idx <- grep(paste0("^", exposure_var), names(co))
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(setNames(numeric(0), character(0)))
  sHR <- exp(co[idx])
  p_e <- fg_prev(fg_data, exposure_var)
  if (is.factor(fg_data[[exposure_var]])) {
    coef_lv <- sub(paste0("^", exposure_var), "", names(co)[idx])
    p_e     <- p_e[coef_lv]
    names(sHR) <- coef_lv
  }
  denom <- 1 + sum(p_e * (sHR - 1))
  (p_e * (sHR - 1)) / denom
}

paf_bootstrap_levels <- function(fg_data, formula, exposure_var,
                                 R = 500, seed = 1, verbose = TRUE) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ids     <- unique(as.character(fg_data$hhidpn))
  n       <- length(ids)
  row_idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(fg_data)), as.character(fg_data$hhidpn))

  # Discover level names from the full-data fit
  fit0   <- coxph(formula, data = fg_data, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron")
  pt_lev <- paf_point_by_level(fit0, fg_data, exposure_var)
  lev    <- names(pt_lev)

  ests <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = R, ncol = length(lev),
                 dimnames = list(NULL, lev))

  for (b in seq_len(R)) {
    samp <- sample(ids, n, replace = TRUE)
    rows <- unlist(row_idx[samp], use.names = FALSE)
    db   <- fg_data[rows, , drop = FALSE]
    fit_b <- tryCatch(
      coxph(formula, data = db, weights = fgwt, ties = "efron"),
      error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(fit_b)) {
      v <- paf_point_by_level(fit_b, db, exposure_var)
      keep <- intersect(lev, names(v))
      ests[b, keep] <- v[keep]
    }
    if (verbose && b %% 50 == 0) cat("  boot rep", b, "/", R, "\n")
  }

  do.call(rbind, lapply(lev, function(L) {
    e <- ests[, L]; e <- e[is.finite(e)]
    tibble::tibble(
      level     = L,
      PAF       = unname(pt_lev[L]),
      lower     = unname(quantile(e, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
      upper     = unname(quantile(e, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
      n_boot_ok = length(e),
      PAF_CI    = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%% to %.1f%%)",
                          100 * pt_lev[L],
                          100 * quantile(e, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                          100 * quantile(e, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  }))
}

paf_row_levels <- function(fit, fg_data, formula, exposure_var, label,
                           R = 500, seed = 1) {
  out <- paf_bootstrap_levels(fg_data, formula, exposure_var, R = R, seed = seed)
  dplyr::mutate(out, model = label, .before = 1)
}

# ---- M5 level-specific PAFs ------------------------------------------
paf_m5_hearing_lev <- paf_row_levels(
  fit_m5_fg_hearing, fg_dat_hearing_m5, m5_formula,
  "ctx_lag", "FG-M5 hearing (ctx)", R = R_boot, seed = 511
)
paf_m5_vision_lev  <- paf_row_levels(
  fit_m5_fg_vision,  fg_dat_vision_m5,  m5_formula,
  "ctx_lag", "FG-M5 vision (ctx)",  R = R_boot, seed = 521
)

print(paf_m5_hearing_lev)
print(paf_m5_vision_lev)

# Sanity check: level PAFs should sum to the joint PAF you printed earlier
cat("Sum of hearing level PAFs:", sum(paf_m5_hearing_lev$PAF), "\n")
cat("Sum of vision  level PAFs:", sum(paf_m5_vision_lev$PAF),  "\n")

# ---- Final PAF table (M5 now uses level-specific rows) ---------------
paf_fg_table <- bind_rows(
  paf_m1_hearing, paf_m1_vision, paf_m1_frailty,
  paf_m2_hearing, paf_m2_vision, paf_m2_frailty,
  paf_m3_hearing, paf_m3_vision, paf_m3_frailty,
  paf_m4_hearing, paf_m4_vision,
  paf_m4_fr_hearing, paf_m4_fr_vision, paf_m4_fr_frailty,
  paf_m5_hearing_lev,        # replaces paf_m5_hearing
  paf_m5_vision_lev          # replaces paf_m5_vision
)
print(paf_fg_table, n = Inf)
```

# Sensitivity analysis: lag dementia outcome by 2 waves (~4 years) (HRS)
# Rationale: address the influence of prevalent-but-undiagnosed dementia at
# baseline by excluding participants whose dementia event was ascertained
# within the first 2 follow-up waves. Models 1-5 and PAFs are re-estimated
# on the restricted sample.
```{r}
# HRS waves are biennial -> 2 waves = 4 years on the (year - baseline_year)
# scale used for Models 1-4 and on the difftime/365.25 scale used for Model 5.
LAG_WAVES <- 2
LAG_YEARS <- LAG_WAVES * 2

# 1) Build lag-restricted analytic sample for Models 1-4
#    Drop any participant whose first dementia event occurred at or before
#    LAG_YEARS of follow-up. Remaining participants keep their full intervals
#    (consistent with "excluding dementia events in the first two waves").
# ============================================================================
early_event_ids <- tv_cc %>%
  group_by(hhidpn) %>%
  summarise(
    first_event_time = suppressWarnings(min(tstop[event == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(first_event_time), first_event_time <= LAG_YEARS) %>%
  pull(hhidpn)

tv_cc_lag <- tv_cc %>%
  filter(!hhidpn %in% early_event_ids)

cat(sprintf(
  "Sensitivity (Models 1-4): excluded %d participants with dementia within %d years\n",
  length(early_event_ids), LAG_YEARS
))
cat(sprintf(
  "  Analytic intervals: %d | unique persons: %d | events: %d\n",
  nrow(tv_cc_lag),
  dplyr::n_distinct(tv_cc_lag$hhidpn),
  sum(tv_cc_lag$event)
))

# ============================================================================
# 2) Model 1 (unadjusted) - lag-restricted
# ============================================================================
fit_m1_hearing_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ hearing_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)
fit_m1_vision_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ vision_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)
fit_m1_frailty_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ frailty_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)

cat("\n--- Model 1 (lag) summaries ---\n")
summary(fit_m1_hearing_lag); cox.zph(fit_m1_hearing_lag)
summary(fit_m1_vision_lag);  cox.zph(fit_m1_vision_lag)
summary(fit_m1_frailty_lag); cox.zph(fit_m1_frailty_lag)

# ============================================================================
# 3) Model 2 (+ age) - lag-restricted
# ============================================================================
fit_m2_hearing_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ hearing_lag + baseline_age + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)
fit_m2_vision_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ vision_lag + baseline_age + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)
fit_m2_frailty_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ frailty_lag + baseline_age + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)

cat("\n--- Model 2 (lag) summaries ---\n")
summary(fit_m2_hearing_lag); cox.zph(fit_m2_hearing_lag)
summary(fit_m2_vision_lag);  cox.zph(fit_m2_vision_lag)
summary(fit_m2_frailty_lag); cox.zph(fit_m2_frailty_lag)

# ============================================================================
# 4) Model 3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle) - lag-restricted
# ============================================================================
fit_m3_hearing_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ hearing_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)
fit_m3_vision_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ vision_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(hhidpn),

    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +

)

cat("\n--- Model 3 (lag) summaries ---\n")
summary(fit_m3_hearing_lag); cox.zph(fit_m3_hearing_lag)
summary(fit_m3_vision_lag);  cox.zph(fit_m3_vision_lag)
summary(fit_m3_frailty_lag); cox.zph(fit_m3_frailty_lag)

# ============================================================================
# 5) Model 4 (PRIMARY hybrid) - lag-restricted
# ============================================================================
fit_m4_hearing_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ hearing_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + frailty_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)
fit_m4_vision_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ vision_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + frailty_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)
fit_m4_frailty_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~
    hearing_lag + vision_lag + frailty_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(hhidpn),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron"
)

cat("\n--- Model 4 (lag) summaries ---\n")
summary(fit_m4_hearing_lag); cox.zph(fit_m4_hearing_lag)
summary(fit_m4_vision_lag);  cox.zph(fit_m4_vision_lag)
summary(fit_m4_frailty_lag); cox.zph(fit_m4_frailty_lag)

# ============================================================================
# 6) Model 5 (3-level sensory x frailty context) - lag-restricted
#    Re-use build_m5_dataset(), drop participants whose dementia event
#    time is <= LAG_YEARS, then refit. Per-level case data is intentionally
#    NOT printed here -- fit_m5() prints it on the lagged dataset.
# ============================================================================

# ---- Self-contained formatter ---------------------------------------------
fmt_int <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")

report_counts <- function(dat, id = "hhidpn", event = "event",
                          ts = "tstart", tp = "tstop", label = "") {
  fmt <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
  n_intervals <- nrow(dat)
  n_persons   <- dplyr::n_distinct(dat[[id]])
  n_events    <- sum(dat[[event]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_pyrs      <- sum(dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]], na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf(
    "%-40s intervals = %s | persons = %s | events = %s | person-years = %s\n",
    label,
    fmt(n_intervals),
    fmt(n_persons),
    fmt(n_events),
    formatC(n_pyrs, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ",")
  ))
  invisible(list(intervals = n_intervals, persons = n_persons,
                 events = n_events, person_years = n_pyrs))
}

# ---- Lag exclusion helper (totals only; fit_m5 handles per-level output) --
apply_lag_m5 <- function(dat, lag_years = LAG_YEARS, label = "") {
  fmt <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")

  early_ids <- dat %>%
    filter(dementia_event == 1L, stop <= lag_years) %>%
    pull(hhidpn) %>%
    unique()

  out <- dat %>% filter(!hhidpn %in% early_ids)

  cat(sprintf("\n[%s] Lag exclusion (<= %g years)\n", label, lag_years))
  cat(sprintf("  Excluded participants (early dementia): %s\n",
              fmt(length(early_ids))))
  report_counts(dat, event = "dementia_event", ts = "start", tp = "stop",
                label = sprintf("  %s primary:", label))
  report_counts(out, event = "dementia_event", ts = "start", tp = "stop",
                label = sprintf("  %s lagged :", label))

  out
}

# ---- Apply lag + refit Model 5 --------------------------------------------
df_tv_hearing_lag <- apply_lag_m5(df_tv_hearing, label = "HEARING")
df_tv_vision_lag  <- apply_lag_m5(df_tv_vision,  label = "VISION")

fit_m5_hearing_lag <- fit_m5(df_tv_hearing_lag, "HEARING (lag 2 waves)")
fit_m5_vision_lag  <- fit_m5(df_tv_vision_lag,  "VISION  (lag 2 waves)")

contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty(fit_m5_hearing_lag, "HEARING (lag)")
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty(fit_m5_vision_lag,  "VISION  (lag)")
```

```{r}
# 7) PAF on the lag-restricted samples
#    Re-uses paf_binary_fn / paf_ci_binary / paf_ci_multicat / prev_pt_*
#    defined in the primary script.
# ============================================================================
set.seed(20260509)

# ---- A) Person-time prevalences in tv_cc_lag (for Models 1-4) -------------
p_hearing_14_lag <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc_lag, "hearing_lag", "tstart", "tstop")
p_vision_14_lag  <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc_lag, "vision_lag",  "tstart", "tstop")
p_frailty_14_lag <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc_lag, "frailty_lag", "tstart", "tstop")

cat("\nPerson-time-weighted prevalence (tv_cc_lag):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Hearing loss : %.4f\n", p_hearing_14_lag))
cat(sprintf("  Vision loss  : %.4f\n", p_vision_14_lag))
cat(sprintf("  Frailty      : %.4f\n", p_frailty_14_lag))

paf_row <- function(fit, term, p, model_label, exposure_label) {
  res <- paf_ci_binary(fit, term, p)
  tibble(
    model    = model_label,
    exposure = exposure_label,
    p_pt     = p,
    HR       = res$HR,
    PAF      = res$PAF,
    PAF_lcl  = res$lcl,
    PAF_ucl  = res$ucl
  )
}

paf_models_1_4_lag <- bind_rows(
  # Model 1
  paf_row(fit_m1_hearing_lag, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14_lag, "M1 (unadjusted) [lag]",          "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m1_vision_lag,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14_lag,  "M1 (unadjusted) [lag]",          "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m1_frailty_lag, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14_lag, "M1 (unadjusted) [lag]",          "Frailty"),

  # Model 2
  paf_row(fit_m2_hearing_lag, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14_lag, "M2 (+ age) [lag]",               "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m2_vision_lag,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14_lag,  "M2 (+ age) [lag]",               "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m2_frailty_lag, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14_lag, "M2 (+ age) [lag]",               "Frailty"),

  # Model 3
  paf_row(fit_m3_hearing_lag, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14_lag, "M3 (+ socio + lifestyle) [lag]", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m3_vision_lag,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14_lag,  "M3 (+ socio + lifestyle) [lag]", "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m3_frailty_lag, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14_lag, "M3 (+ socio + lifestyle) [lag]", "Frailty"),

  # Model 4 (PRIMARY hybrid)
  paf_row(fit_m4_hearing_lag, "hearing_lag", p_hearing_14_lag, "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj) [lag]", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m4_vision_lag,  "vision_lag",  p_vision_14_lag,  "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj) [lag]", "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m4_frailty_lag, "frailty_lag", p_frailty_14_lag, "M4 (mutually adjusted) [lag]",   "Frailty")
)

cat("\n--- PAF: Models 1-4 (lag) ---\n")
print(paf_models_1_4_lag, n = Inf)

# ---- B) PAF for Model 5 (lag) ---------------------------------------------
paf_model5 <- function(fit, dat, model_label) {
  stopifnot(is.factor(dat$ctx_lag))
  ctx_levels   <- levels(dat$ctx_lag)
  exposed_lvls <- ctx_levels[-1]

  prev_tab  <- prev_pt_factor(dat, "ctx_lag", "start", "stop")
  p_exposed <- setNames(prev_tab$p[match(exposed_lvls, prev_tab$level)],
                        exposed_lvls)
  stopifnot(all(!is.na(p_exposed)), all(p_exposed > 0))

  terms <- paste0("ctx_lag", exposed_lvls)
  miss  <- setdiff(terms, names(coef(fit)))
  if (length(miss))
    stop("Missing coefficients in Model 5 fit: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  tab <- paf_ci_multicat(fit, terms, p_exposed, exposed_lvls)
  tab %>%
    mutate(
      model    = model_label,
      exposure = component,
      p_pt     = c(NA_real_, unname(p_exposed))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl = lcl, PAF_ucl = ucl)
}

paf_m5_hearing_lag <- paf_model5(fit_m5_hearing_lag, df_tv_hearing_lag,
                                 "M5 (hearing context) [lag]")
paf_m5_vision_lag  <- paf_model5(fit_m5_vision_lag,  df_tv_vision_lag,
                                 "M5 (vision context) [lag]")

cat("\n--- PAF: Model 5 hearing (lag) ---\n"); print(paf_m5_hearing_lag, n = Inf)
cat("\n--- PAF: Model 5 vision  (lag) ---\n"); print(paf_m5_vision_lag,  n = Inf)

# ---- C) Combined summary (lag) --------------------------------------------
paf_all_lag <- bind_rows(paf_models_1_4_lag, paf_m5_hearing_lag, paf_m5_vision_lag) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI  = ifelse(is.na(HR), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", HR)),
    PAF_CI = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",
                     100 * PAF, 100 * PAF_lcl, 100 * PAF_ucl)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl, PAF_CI)

cat("\n=== Combined PAF summary - SENSITIVITY (lag 2 waves) ===\n")
print(paf_all_lag, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================================================
# 3) Model 5 — parameterised build_m5_dataset() taking a frailty_var arg
# Sanity guards — fail loudly if HRS objects aren't actually in scope.
# (Prevents accidentally feeding ELSA tibbles into an HRS pipeline.)
# ==========================================================================
stopifnot(
  "hhidpn" %in% names(panel_df_eligible),
  "hhidpn" %in% names(baseline_df_eligible),
  "Frailty_status_noIADL" %in% names(panel_df_eligible)
)

# Self-contained helper — redefined here so the sensitivity block doesn't
# depend on whatever may have been overwritten earlier in the session.
make_midyear_date_hrs <- function(y) lubridate::ymd(paste0(as.integer(y), "-06-15"))

# ==========================================================================
# build_m5_dataset_hrs — same logic as before, but:
#   * suffixed `_hrs` so an ELSA version can't shadow it
#   * uses the local make_midyear_date_hrs
#   * frailty_var defaults to "Frailty_status"; pass "Frailty_status_noIADL"
#     for the sensitivity run
# ==========================================================================
build_m5_dataset_hrs <- function(panel_df, baseline_df,
                                 sensory_var, sensory_label,
                                 frailty_var = "Frailty_status") {

  stopifnot(
    "hhidpn"     %in% names(panel_df),
    "hhidpn"     %in% names(baseline_df),
    sensory_var  %in% names(panel_df),
    frailty_var  %in% names(panel_df)
  )

  df_tv <- panel_df %>%
    mutate(
      hhidpn        = as.character(hhidpn),
      year          = as.integer(year),
      baseline_year = as.integer(baseline_year),
      int_date      = make_midyear_date_hrs(year),
      baseline_date = make_midyear_date_hrs(baseline_year),
      time          = as.numeric(difftime(int_date, baseline_date,
                                          units = "days")) / 365.25,
      .sensory      = .data[[sensory_var]],
      .frailty      = .data[[frailty_var]]
    ) %>%
    arrange(hhidpn, time) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(
      sensory_onset_time = if (any(.sensory == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[.sensory == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      frailty_onset_time = if (any(.frailty == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[.frailty == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      dem_time           = if (any(dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
                            min(time[dementia == 1], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(sensory_tv = dplyr::if_else(.sensory == 1, 1L, 0L)) %>%
    arrange(hhidpn, time) %>%
    group_by(hhidpn) %>%
    mutate(
      start = lag(time),
      stop  = time,
      dementia_event  = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(dem_time) & stop == dem_time, 1L, 0L),
      frailty_by_stop = !is.na(frailty_onset_time) & frailty_onset_time <= stop,
      ctx_tv = case_when(
        sensory_tv == 0                     ~ 0L,
        sensory_tv == 1 & !frailty_by_stop  ~ 1L,
        sensory_tv == 1 &  frailty_by_stop  ~ 2L,
        TRUE                                ~ NA_integer_
      ),
      ctx_lag     = lag(ctx_tv),
      emp_lag     = lag(Employment),
      smoke_lag   = lag(Smoking),
      alcohol_lag = lag(Alcohol)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(start),
      stop > start,
      is.na(dem_time) | start < dem_time,
      !is.na(ctx_lag)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ctx_lag = factor(
        ctx_lag, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
        labels = c(paste0("No ", sensory_label, " (ref)"),
                   paste0(sensory_label, ", no frailty yet"),
                   paste0(sensory_label, ", frailty present"))
      ),
      emp_lag     = droplevels(factor(emp_lag)),
      smoke_lag   = droplevels(factor(smoke_lag)),
      alcohol_lag = droplevels(factor(alcohol_lag))
    )

  baseline_invariant_local <- baseline_df %>%
    dplyr::select(hhidpn, Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, age) %>%
    rename(baseline_age = age) %>%
    mutate(hhidpn = as.character(hhidpn))

  df_tv %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of(c("Gender", "Race", "Education", "Marital_status"))) %>%
    left_join(baseline_invariant_local, by = "hhidpn") %>%
    mutate(
      baseline_age   = as.numeric(baseline_age),
      Gender         = droplevels(factor(Gender)),
      Race           = droplevels(factor(Race)),
      Education      = droplevels(factor(Education)),
      Marital_status = droplevels(factor(Marital_status))
    )
}

# ==========================================================================
# fit_m5_hrs — HRS-specific Cox fitter (cluster = hhidpn)
# ==========================================================================
fit_m5_hrs <- function(dat, label) {
  stopifnot("hhidpn" %in% names(dat))

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat(label, "Model 5 (3-level, reference = No sensory impairment)\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat("Intervals:", nrow(dat),
      "| Events:",  sum(dat$dementia_event),
      "| People:",  dplyr::n_distinct(dat$hhidpn), "\n\n")

  cat("Category distribution (lagged, interval-level):\n")
  print(table(dat$ctx_lag, useNA = "ifany"))

  cat("\nEvents by category:\n")
  print(
    dat %>%
      group_by(ctx_lag) %>%
      summarise(intervals = n(), events = sum(dementia_event),
                .groups = "drop")
  )

  fit <- coxph(
    Surv(start, stop, dementia_event) ~
      ctx_lag + baseline_age +
      Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
      emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag,
    data = dat, cluster = hhidpn, ties = "efron", na.action = na.omit
  )

  cat("\n--- Cox fit ---\n");  print(summary(fit))
  cat("\n--- PH check ---\n"); print(cox.zph(fit))
  fit
}

# ==========================================================================
# contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_hrs — coefficient-only; safe across cohorts
# (kept local so the sensitivity block has no external dependencies)
# ==========================================================================
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_hrs <- function(fit, label) {
  co <- coef(fit)
  vc <- vcov(fit)
  i_no_fr  <- grep("no frailty yet",  names(co))
  i_fr_yes <- grep("frailty present", names(co))

  stopifnot(length(i_no_fr) == 1, length(i_fr_yes) == 1)

  L <- numeric(length(co))
  L[i_fr_yes] <-  1
  L[i_no_fr]  <- -1

  est <- sum(L * co)
  se  <- sqrt(t(L) %*% vc %*% L)[1, 1]
  z   <- est / se
  p   <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n[%s] log-HR(frailty present) - log-HR(no frailty yet) = %.3f (SE %.3f), z = %.2f, p = %.4f\n",
    label, est, se, z, p
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "  Ratio of HRs (frailty present / no frailty yet) = %.2f (95%% CI %.2f-%.2f)\n",
    exp(est), exp(est - 1.96 * se), exp(est + 1.96 * se)
  ))
  invisible(list(estimate = est, se = se, p = p,
                 ratio = exp(est),
                 ci = exp(est + c(-1, 1) * 1.96 * se)))
}

# ==========================================================================
# Build & fit the two sensitivity M5 models
# ==========================================================================
df_tv_hearing_noIADL <- build_m5_dataset_hrs(
  panel_df_eligible, baseline_df_eligible,
  sensory_var   = "hearing_loss",
  sensory_label = "Hearing loss",
  frailty_var   = "Frailty_status_noIADL"
)

df_tv_vision_noIADL  <- build_m5_dataset_hrs(
  panel_df_eligible, baseline_df_eligible,
  sensory_var   = "vision_overall",
  sensory_label = "Vision loss",
  frailty_var   = "Frailty_status_noIADL"
)

fit_m5_hearing_noIADL <- fit_m5_hrs(df_tv_hearing_noIADL, "HEARING (noIADL)")
fit_m5_vision_noIADL  <- fit_m5_hrs(df_tv_vision_noIADL,  "VISION (noIADL)")

contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_hrs(fit_m5_hearing_noIADL, "HEARING (noIADL)")
contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty_hrs(fit_m5_vision_noIADL,  "VISION (noIADL)")

```

```{r}
# 4) PAF (sensitivity) — reuse helpers defined in the main script

p_hearing_s <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc_noIADL, "hearing_lag",        "tstart", "tstop")
p_vision_s  <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc_noIADL, "vision_lag",         "tstart", "tstop")
p_frailty_s <- prev_pt_binary(tv_cc_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL", "tstart", "tstop")

cat("\n[Sensitivity] Person-time prevalence:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Hearing loss        : %.4f\n", p_hearing_s))
cat(sprintf("  Vision loss         : %.4f\n", p_vision_s))
cat(sprintf("  Frailty (no (I)ADL) : %.4f\n", p_frailty_s))

paf_models_1_4_noIADL <- bind_rows(
  paf_row(fit_m1_hearing_noIADL, "hearing_lag",        p_hearing_s, "M1 (unadjusted)",                     "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m1_vision_noIADL,  "vision_lag",         p_vision_s,  "M1 (unadjusted)",                     "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m1_frailty_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL", p_frailty_s, "M1 (unadjusted)",                     "Frailty (noIADL)"),

  paf_row(fit_m2_hearing_noIADL, "hearing_lag",        p_hearing_s, "M2 (+ age)",                          "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m2_vision_noIADL,  "vision_lag",         p_vision_s,  "M2 (+ age)",                          "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m2_frailty_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL", p_frailty_s, "M2 (+ age)",                          "Frailty (noIADL)"),

  paf_row(fit_m3_hearing_noIADL, "hearing_lag",        p_hearing_s, "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)", "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m3_vision_noIADL,  "vision_lag",         p_vision_s,  "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)", "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m3_frailty_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL", p_frailty_s, "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)", "Frailty (noIADL)"),

  paf_row(fit_m4_hearing_noIADL, "hearing_lag",        p_hearing_s, "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj, noIADL)",    "Hearing loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m4_vision_noIADL,  "vision_lag",         p_vision_s,  "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj, noIADL)",    "Vision loss"),
  paf_row(fit_m4_frailty_noIADL, "frailty_lag_noIADL", p_frailty_s, "M4 (mutually adjusted, noIADL)",      "Frailty (noIADL)")
)

paf_m5_hearing_noIADL <- paf_model5(fit_m5_hearing_noIADL, df_tv_hearing_noIADL,
                                    "M5 (hearing context, noIADL)")
paf_m5_vision_noIADL  <- paf_model5(fit_m5_vision_noIADL,  df_tv_vision_noIADL,
                                    "M5 (vision context, noIADL)")

paf_all_noIADL <- bind_rows(paf_models_1_4_noIADL,
                            paf_m5_hearing_noIADL,
                            paf_m5_vision_noIADL) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI  = ifelse(is.na(HR), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", HR)),
    PAF_CI = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",
                     100 * PAF, 100 * PAF_lcl, 100 * PAF_ucl)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl, PAF_CI)

cat("\n=== SENSITIVITY PAF summary (Models 1-5, no-(I)ADL FI) ===\n")
print(paf_all_noIADL, n = Inf)

# ==========================================================================
# 5) Side-by-side comparison: main vs sensitivity
# ==========================================================================
paf_compare <- bind_rows(
  paf_all        %>% mutate(analysis = "Main (49-item FI)"),
  paf_all_noIADL %>% mutate(analysis = "Sensitivity (noIADL FI)")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(analysis, model, exposure, HR, PAF, PAF_CI) %>%
  arrange(model, exposure, analysis)

cat("\n=== Main vs sensitivity: HR and PAF side-by-side ===\n")
print(paf_compare, n = Inf)
```
